1.159.s:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
bhagavañchrotumicchāmi dvādaśīṣu pṛthakpṛthak ..
upoṣya ki phalaṃ loke śuklapakṣe vidhīyate .. 1 ..
1.159.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि द्वादशीषु पृथक्पृथक् ॥
उपोष्य कि फलं लोके शुक्लपक्षे विधीयते ॥ 1 ॥
1.159.m:
Vajra said:
O venerable one, I wish to hear about the Dvādaśīs individually: / having fasted in the bright fortnight, what fruit is declared in the world?

1.159.s:
anekajanmasāhasrairyeṣāṃ pāpaṃ kṣaya gatam ..
akāmāste pravartante devadevārcane narāḥ .. 2 ..
1.159.d:
अनेकजन्मसाहस्रैर्येषां पापं क्षय गतम् ॥
अकामास्ते प्रवर्तन्ते देवदेवार्चने नराः ॥ 2 ॥
1.159.m: Those men whose sin has been destroyed over many thousands of births / engage without desire in the worship of the God of gods.

1.159.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya śuklapakṣe upoṣitaḥ ..
nāmnā keśavamabhyarcya vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
1.159.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
द्वादश्यां मार्गशीर्षस्य शुक्लपक्षे उपोषितः ॥
नाम्ना केशवमभ्यर्च्य वह्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.159.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Fasting on the Dvādaśī of the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa / and worshipping Keśava by name, one obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

1.159.s:
nārāyaṇaṃ tathābhyarcya pauṣe māse jagatpatim ..
atyagniṣṭomamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 4 ..
1.159.d:
नारायणं तथाभ्यर्च्य पौषे मासे जगत्पतिम् ॥
अत्यग्निष्टोममाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 4 ॥
1.159.m: Likewise, worshipping Nārāyaṇa, the lord of the world, in the month of Pauṣa, / one attains an Atyagniṣṭoma; no doubt should be had here.

1.159.s:
māghe mādhavamabhyarcya dvādaśābdaphalaṃ labhet ..
govindaṃ phālgune māsi pūjayitvā mahī dhara .. 5 ..
1.159.d:
माघे माधवमभ्यर्च्य द्वादशाब्दफलं लभेत् ॥
गोविन्दं फाल्गुने मासि पूजयित्वा मही धर ॥ 5 ॥
1.159.m: Worshipping Mādhava in Māgha, one obtains the fruit of a twelve-year sacrifice. / Having worshipped Govinda in the month of Phālguna, O supporter of the earth,

1.159.s:
atirātrasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam ..
caitre viṣṇumathābhyarcya vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet .. 6 ..
1.159.d:
अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥
चैत्रे विष्णुमथाभ्यर्च्य वाजपेयफलं लभेत् ॥ 6 ॥
1.159.m: one undoubtedly obtains the fruit of the Atirātra sacrifice. / Then, worshipping Viṣṇu in Caitra, one obtains the fruit of a Vājapeya sacrifice.

1.159.s:
dvādaśyāṃ māsi vaiśākhe sampūjya madhusūdanam ..
gosavasya tu yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam .. 7 ..
1.159.d:
द्वादश्यां मासि वैशाखे सम्पूज्य मधुसूदनम् ॥
गोसवस्य तु यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.159.m: Worshipping Madhusūdana on the Dvādaśī in the month of Vaiśākha, / one obtains the unsurpassed fruit of the Gosava sacrifice.

1.159.s:
jyeṣṭhe māse tathābhyarcya devadevaṃ trivikramam ..
puṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ .. 8 ..
1.159.d:
ज्येष्ठे मासे तथाभ्यर्च्य देवदेवं त्रिविक्रमम् ॥
पुण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलं विन्दति मानवः ॥ 8 ॥
1.159.m: Likewise, worshipping the God of gods, Trivikrama, in the month of Jyeṣṭha, / a person finds the fruit of the Puṇḍarīka sacrifice.

1.159.s:
āṣāḍhe vāmanaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā jagatpatim ..
kṣiprameva samāpnoti yajñaṃ bahusuvarṇakam .. 9 ..
1.159.d:
आषाढे वामनं देवं पूजयित्वा जगत्पतिम् ॥
क्षिप्रमेव समाप्नोति यज्ञं बहुसुवर्णकम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.159.m: Having worshipped the god Vāmana, the lord of the world, in Āṣāḍha, / one quickly attains [the fruit of] the Bahusuvarṇaka sacrifice.

1.159.s:
śrīdharaṃ śrāvaṇe māsi pūjayitvā maheśvaram ..
vaiṣṇavasya tu yajñasya phalaṃ vindatyasaṃśayam .. 1.159.10 ..
1.159.d:
श्रीधरं श्रावणे मासि पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् ॥
वैष्णवस्य तु यज्ञस्य फलं विन्दत्यसंशयम् ॥ 1.159.10 ॥
1.159.m: Having worshipped the great lord Śrīdhara in the month of Śrāvaṇa, / one undoubtedly finds the fruit of the Vaiṣṇava sacrifice.

1.159.s:
māse bhādrapade devaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ samarcayan ..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet .. 11 ..
1.159.d:
मासे भाद्रपदे देवं हृषीकेशं समर्चयन् ॥
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत् ॥ 11 ॥
1.159.m: Worshipping the god Hṛṣīkeśa in the month of Bhādrapada, / one attains an Aśvamedha sacrifice and saves his family.

1.159.s:
āśvine māsi saṃprāpte padmanābhaṃ samarcayan ..
rājasūyamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 12 ..
1.159.d:
आश्विने मासि संप्राप्ते पद्मनाभं समर्चयन् ॥
राजसूयमवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 12 ॥
1.159.m: When the month of Āśvina arrives, worshipping Padmanābha, / he obtains [the fruit of] a Rājasūya sacrifice; there should be no doubt about this.

1.159.s:
dāmodaramathābhyarcya kārtike māsi yādava ..
sarvamedhamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 13 ..
1.159.d:
दामोदरमथाभ्यर्च्य कार्तिके मासि यादव ॥
सर्वमेधमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 13 ॥
1.159.m: Then, having worshipped Dāmodara in the month of Kārtika, O Yādava, / he obtains [the fruit of] a Sarvamedha sacrifice and goes to the world of heaven.

1.159.s:
māsoktena sadā nāmnā śuklapakṣe hyupoṣitaḥ ..
dvādaśīṣu sadā kuryājjapyahomānsamāhitaḥ .. 14 ..
1.159.d:
मासोक्तेन सदा नाम्ना शुक्लपक्षे ह्युपोषितः ॥
द्वादशीषु सदा कुर्याज्जप्यहोमान्समाहितः ॥ 14 ॥
1.159.m: Fasting on the twelfth [lunar days] in the bright fortnight, / with concentrated mind he should constantly perform recitations and oblations using the name declared for that month.

1.159.s:
saṃvatsarānte dātavyaṃ ghṛtapūrṇaṃ ca bhājanam ..
kāṃsyasya vainateyaṃ ca rukmapatraniveśitam .. 15 ..
1.159.d:
संवत्सरान्ते दातव्यं घृतपूर्णं च भाजनम् ॥
कांस्यस्य वैनतेयं च रुक्मपत्रनिवेशितम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.159.m: At the end of the year, a vessel made of bell-metal filled with clarified butter / and [an image of] Vainateya placed upon a leaf of gold should be given.

1.159.s:
kramopavāsatastvete proktā yajñaphalā nṛpa ..
pūrṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā vratametannarādhipa .. 16 ..
1.159.d:
क्रमोपवासतस्त्वेते प्रोक्ता यज्ञफला नृप ॥
पूर्णं संवत्सरं कृत्वा व्रतमेतन्नराधिप ॥ 16 ॥
1.159.m: These sacrifices are proclaimed to bear fruit according to the order of fasts, O king. / Having performed this vow for a full year, O ruler of men,

1.159.s:
svargalokamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet ..
devarāmāgaṇasthena vīṇāgurujanādinā .. 17 ..
1.159.d:
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत् ॥
देवरामागणस्थेन वीणागुरुजनादिना ॥ 17 ॥
1.159.m: he attains the world of heaven and also delivers his family. / Abiding among hosts of divine women, with the resounding sounds of lutes and elders,

1.159.s:
haṃsasārasayuktena vimānenārkavarcasā ..
kiṅkiṇīśataghoṣeṇa viharatyamaraprabhaḥ .. 18 ..
1.159.d:
हंससारसयुक्तेन विमानेनार्कवर्चसा ॥
किङ्किणीशतघोषेण विहरत्यमरप्रभः ॥ 18 ॥
1.159.m: in an aerial chariot yoked with swans and cranes, having the splendour of the sun / and echoing with the sound of hundreds of tiny bells, he sports, shining like an immortal.

1.159.s:
yāvajjīvaṃ naraḥ kuryādvratametatsamāhitaḥ ..
śvetadvīpamavāpnoti yatra candraprabhā narāḥ .. 19 ..
1.159.d:
यावज्जीवं नरः कुर्याद्व्रतमेतत्समाहितः ॥
श्वेतद्वीपमवाप्नोति यत्र चन्द्रप्रभा नराः ॥ 19 ॥
1.159.m: If a man should perform this vow with a concentrated mind for as long as he lives, / he reaches Śvetadvīpa, where the men possess the lustre of the moon,

1.159.s:
caturbhujā mahāsattvā nityatṛptāḥ sugandhinaḥ ..
aniṣyandā nirāhārāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ .. 1.159.20 ..
1.159.d:
चतुर्भुजा महासत्त्वा नित्यतृप्ताः सुगन्धिनः ॥
अनिष्यन्दा निराहाराः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः ॥ 1.159.20 ॥
1.159.m: four-armed, of great strength, perpetually satisfied, fragrant, / free from exudation, taking no food, omniscient, all-seeing.

1.159.s:
tatroṣya kālaṃ suciraṃ narendra bhittvārkabimbaṃ sahasā prayāti ..
sthānaṃ puro devavarasya viṣṇornityasya tasyānagha sarvagamya .. 21 ..
1.159.d:
तत्रोष्य कालं सुचिरं नरेन्द्र भित्त्वार्कबिम्बं सहसा प्रयाति ॥
स्थानं पुरो देववरस्य विष्णोर्नित्यस्य तस्यानघ सर्वगम्य ॥ 21 ॥
1.159.m: Having dwelt there for a very long time, O ruler of men, having suddenly pierced the disc of the sun, / he goes to the foremost realm of the eternal, supreme god Viṣṇu, accessible to all, O sinless one.

1.160.s:
vajra uvāca ..
kevalaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśīṣu janārdanam ..
kadāprabhṛti dharmajña vidhinā kena cārcayet .. 1 ..
1.160.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
केवलं कृष्णपक्षस्य द्वादशीषु जनार्दनम् ॥
कदाप्रभृति धर्मज्ञ विधिना केन चार्चयेत् ॥ 1 ॥
1.160.m: Vajra said: / Beginning from when, O knower of dharma, and by what rule / should one worship Janārdana only on the twelfth [lunar days] of the dark fortnight?

1.160.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
mārgyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ dvādaśī yā bhavennṛpa ..
tataḥ prabhṛti kartavyaṃ vratamevamupoṣitaḥ .. 2 ..
1.160.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
मार्ग्यां तु समतीतायां द्वादशी या भवेन्नृप ॥
ततः प्रभृति कर्तव्यं व्रतमेवमुपोषितः ॥ 2 ॥
1.160.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Mārgaśīrṣa has passed, whatever twelfth [lunar day] occurs, O king, / from then on, having fasted, this vow is to be performed.

1.160.s:
dvādaśīṣu ca kṛṣṇāsu nāma kṛṣṇasya kīrtayet ..
tenaiva nāmnā kartavyau japahomau tathaiva ca .. 3 ..
1.160.d:
द्वादशीषु च कृष्णासु नाम कृष्णस्य कीर्तयेत् ॥
तेनैव नाम्ना कर्तव्यौ जपहोमौ तथैव च ॥ 3 ॥
1.160.m: And on the twelfth [lunar days] of the dark [fortnight], he should recite the name of Kṛṣṇa; / with that very name, recitation and oblation are likewise to be performed.

1.160.s:
tilairnivedanaṃ kāryaṃ homaḥ kāryastathā tilaiḥ ..
pauṣyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇā yā dvādaśī bhavet .. 4 ..
1.160.d:
तिलैर्निवेदनं कार्यं होमः कार्यस्तथा तिलैः ॥
पौष्यां तु समतीतायां कृष्णा या द्वादशी भवेत् ॥ 4 ॥
1.160.m: An offering should be made with sesame seeds, and the oblation is likewise to be made with sesame seeds. / When the full moon of Pauṣa has passed, on whichever dark twelfth [day] occurs,

1.160.s:
tasyāṃ vratāvasāne tu tilāndadyāddvijātiṣu ..
suvarṇaṃ ca mahīpāla raktavastraṃ tathaiva ca .. 5 ..
1.160.d:
तस्यां व्रतावसाने तु तिलान्दद्याद्द्विजातिषु ॥
सुवर्णं च महीपाल रक्तवस्त्रं तथैव च ॥ 5 ॥
1.160.m: on that [day], at the conclusion of the vow, he should bestow sesame seeds on the twice-born, / and gold, O protector of the earth, as well as red cloth.

1.160.s:
samvatsaramidaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ manujapuṅgava ..
tiryagyoniṃ na cāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 6 ..
1.160.d:
सम्वत्सरमिदं कृत्वा व्रतं मनुजपुङ्गव ॥
तिर्यग्योनिं न चाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति ॥ 6 ॥
1.160.m: Having performed this vow for a year, O best among men, / he does not enter an animal womb and goes to the world of heaven.

1.160.s:
yāvajjīvaṃ vratamidaṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ ..
na sa dukhaṃ samāpnoti narakaṃ na narādhipa .. 7 ..
1.160.d:
यावज्जीवं व्रतमिदं यः करोति समाहितः ॥
न स दुखं समाप्नोति नरकं न नराधिप ॥ 7 ॥
1.160.m: Whoever performs this vow with a concentrated mind as long as he lives, / he does not experience suffering, nor hell, O ruler of men.

1.160.s:
yatra vaitaraṇī durgā kṣuradhārāśca parvatāḥ ..
pāpānāṃ yātanā yatra tatrāsau na gamiṣyati .. 8 ..
1.160.d:
यत्र वैतरणी दुर्गा क्षुरधाराश्च पर्वताः ॥
पापानां यातना यत्र तत्रासौ न गमिष्यति ॥ 8 ॥
1.160.m: Where the impassable Vaitaraṇī flows and mountains are sharp as razor-edges, / where the torments of sinners [take place], thither he shall not go.

1.160.s:
yasyāṃ gaṇāḥ bhīmabalā mahogrā daṃṣṭrākarālā vikaṭograveṣāḥ ..
vidrāvaṇāḥ pāpakṛtāṃ narāṇāṃ na yena tasyā nṛpa yanti mārgam .. 9 ..
1.160.d:
यस्यां गणाः भीमबला महोग्रा दंष्ट्राकराला विकटोग्रवेषाः ॥
विद्रावणाः पापकृतां नराणां न येन तस्या नृप यन्ति मार्गम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.160.m: On which [road] hordes of terrible might, exceedingly fierce, with frightful fangs and hideous, terrible forms, / routing sinful men, [abide], along its path they do not go, O king.

1.161.s:
vajra uvāca ..
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ śuklapakṣe dvijottama ..
ekā yā dvādaśī puṇyā tāṃ vadasva mamānagha ..1..
1.161.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
उपवासासमर्थानां शुक्लपक्षे द्विजोत्तम ॥
एका या द्वादशी पुण्या तां वदस्व ममानघ ॥1॥
1.161.m: Vajra said: / For those incapable of fasting during the bright fortnight, O best of the twice-born, / tell me of that single meritorious twelfth [day], O sinless one.

1.161.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā..
mahatī dvādaśī jñeyā upavāse mahāphalā .. 2 ..
1.161.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
मासि भाद्रपदे शुक्ला द्वादशी श्रवणान्विता॥
महती द्वादशी ज्ञेया उपवासे महाफला ॥ 2 ॥
1.161.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the month of Bhādrapada, the bright twelfth [day] conjoined with the Śravaṇa asterism / is to be known as the Great Twelfth; it bears great fruit for one who fasts.

1.161.s:
saṅgame saritoḥ puṇye dvādaśīṃ tāmupoṣitaḥ ..
ayatnādevamāpnoti dvādaśadvādaśīphalam .. 3 ..
1.161.d:
सङ्गमे सरितोः पुण्ये द्वादशीं तामुपोषितः ॥
अयत्नादेवमाप्नोति द्वादशद्वादशीफलम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.161.m: Fasting on that twelfth [day] at the holy confluence of two rivers, / one effortlessly obtains the fruit of twelve twelfth [days].

1.161.s:
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā saiva ceddvādaśī bhavet ..
atyantamahatī yasyāṃ sarvaṃ kṛtamathākṣayam .. 4 ..
1.161.d:
बुधश्रवणसंयुक्ता सैव चेद्द्वादशी भवेत् ॥
अत्यन्तमहती यस्यां सर्वं कृतमथाक्षयम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.161.m: If that very twelfth [day] is conjoined with Wednesday and the Śravaṇa asterism, / it is an exceedingly great [day], on which everything done becomes imperishable.

1.161.s:
dvādaśī śravaṇopetā yadā bhavati pārthiva ...
saṅgame tu tadā snātvā sattīrthasnānajaṃ phalam ..5..
1.161.d:
द्वादशी श्रवणोपेता यदा भवति पार्थिव ॥।
सङ्गमे तु तदा स्नात्वा सत्तीर्थस्नानजं फलम् ॥5॥
1.161.m: When the twelfth [day] is attended by Śravaṇa, O king, / then, having bathed at a confluence, the fruit born of bathing in an excellent holy ford

1.161.s:
sopavāsaḥ samāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
vāridhānīṃ tadā dattvā jalapūrṇāṃ dvijātaye ..6..
1.161.d:
सोपवासः समाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
वारिधानीं तदा दत्त्वा जलपूर्णां द्विजातये ॥6॥
1.161.m: one who observes a fast attains; there should be no doubt about this. / Giving then a water-vessel filled with water to a twice-born,

1.161.s:
channāṃ vastrayutāṃ rājañchatropānahasaṃyutām ..
svargalokamavāpnoti kulamuddharati svakam .. 7 ..
1.161.d:
छन्नां वस्त्रयुतां राजञ्छत्रोपानहसंयुताम् ॥
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति कुलमुद्धरति स्वकम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.161.m: covered and provided with cloth, O king, together with an umbrella and sandals, / he attains the world of heaven and delivers his own family.

1.161.s:
svargaṃ samāsādya ciraṃ ca bhogānbhuktvā mahendropama devatulyān ..
mānuṣyamāsādya bhavatyarogo dhanānvito dharmaparo manasvī ..8..
1.161.d:
स्वर्गं समासाद्य चिरं च भोगान्भुक्त्वा महेन्द्रोपम देवतुल्यान् ॥
मानुष्यमासाद्य भवत्यरोगो धनान्वितो धर्मपरो मनस्वी ॥8॥
1.161.m: Having reached heaven and for a long time enjoyed pleasures equal to those of the gods, resembling great Indra, / upon attaining human birth he becomes free of disease, endowed with wealth, devoted to dharma, and wise.

1.162.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
mahatyaraṇye yadvṛttaṃ bhūmipāla purātanam ..1..
1.162.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥
महत्यरण्ये यद्वृत्तं भूमिपाल पुरातनम् ॥1॥
1.162.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Regarding this, they also cite this ancient narrative / of what occurred in a great wilderness in former times, O protector of the earth.

1.162.s:
deśā dāśerakā nāma teṣāṃ bhāge tu paścime ..
asti rājanmarurdeśaḥ sarvasattvabhayaṅkaraḥ ..2..
1.162.d:
देशा दाशेरका नाम तेषां भागे तु पश्चिमे ॥
अस्ति राजन्मरुर्देशः सर्वसत्त्वभयङ्करः ॥2॥
1.162.m: There are lands named Dāśeraka, and in their western part, / O king, there is a desert region terrifying to all living beings,

1.162.s:
sutaptasikatā bhūmiryatra duṣṭa mahoragā ..
svalpacchāyāsamākīrṇā mṛtaprāṇisamākulā..3..
1.162.d:
सुतप्तसिकता भूमिर्यत्र दुष्ट महोरगा ॥
स्वल्पच्छायासमाकीर्णा मृतप्राणिसमाकुला॥3॥
1.162.m: where the ground has burning sand, where there are wicked, great serpents, / strewn with meager shade, and crowded with dead creatures.

1.162.s:
śamīkhadiraphullāsakarīrāḥ pailubhiḥ saha ..
tatra bhīmā drumagaṇāḥ kaṇṭakairāvṛtāḥ samam..4..
1.162.d:
शमीखदिरफुल्लासकरीराः पैलुभिः सह ॥
तत्र भीमा द्रुमगणाः कण्टकैरावृताः समम्॥4॥
1.162.m: Śamī, khadira, phullāsa, and karīra trees together with pīlu trees— / there stand terrible clusters of trees, entirely covered with thorns.

1.162.s:
caṇḍaprāṇigaṇākīrṇā tatra bhūmistathā kvacit ..
atyantatāpaviṣamā nistṛṇā paruṣopalā .. 5 ..
1.162.d:
चण्डप्राणिगणाकीर्णा तत्र भूमिस्तथा क्वचित् ॥
अत्यन्ततापविषमा निस्तृणा परुषोपला ॥ 5 ॥
1.162.m: In places the ground there is crowded with hosts of fierce creatures, / made uneven by extreme heat, devoid of grass, and strewn with rough stones.

1.162.s:
nāśrayastatra nāhāro jvalitāgnisame bhṛśam ..
tathāpi tatra jīvanti janāḥ karmanibandhanāt .. 6 ..
1.162.d:
नाश्रयस्तत्र नाहारो ज्वलिताग्निसमे भृशम् ॥
तथापि तत्र जीवन्ति जनाः कर्मनिबन्धनात् ॥ 6 ॥
1.162.m: There is no shelter there and no food, as if [in the midst of] a blazingly kindled fire; / even so, people live there due to the bondage of their past deeds.

1.162.s:
nodakaṃ nodakadharā rājaṃstatra balāhakāḥ ..
kadācidapi dṛśyante deśe nirayasannibhe .. 7 ..
1.162.d:
नोदकं नोदकधरा राजंस्तत्र बलाहकाः ॥
कदाचिदपि दृश्यन्ते देशे निरयसन्निभे ॥ 7 ॥
1.162.m: Neither water nor water-bearing clouds, O king, / are ever seen there in that land resembling hell.

1.162.s:
tatra pakṣāntaragataistṛṣitaiḥ śiśubhiḥ saha ..
utkrāntajīvitā rājandṛśyante'tha vihaṅgamāḥ .. 8 ..
1.162.d:
तत्र पक्षान्तरगतैस्तृषितैः शिशुभिः सह ॥
उत्क्रान्तजीविता राजन्दृश्यन्तेऽथ विहङ्गमाः ॥ 8 ॥
1.162.m: There, birds with their thirsty fledglings resting under their wings / are seen, O king, with their lives departed.

1.162.s:
utplutyotplutya sahasā mṛgāḥ saikatamālayāta ..
saikateṣveva naśyanti jale saikatasetuvat ..9..
1.162.d:
उत्प्लुत्योत्प्लुत्य सहसा मृगाः सैकतमालयात ॥
सैकतेष्वेव नश्यन्ति जले सैकतसेतुवत् ॥9॥
1.162.m: Deer, leaping up again and again suddenly from the expanse of sand, / perish in the very sands like a causeway of sand in water.

1.162.s:
tasmiṃstathāvidhe deśe kaściddaivavaśādvaṇik ..
vanamātapavibhraṣṭaḥ praviṣṭastu paribhraman ..1.162.10..
1.162.d:
तस्मिंस्तथाविधे देशे कश्चिद्दैववशाद्वणिक् ॥
वनमातपविभ्रष्टः प्रविष्टस्तु परिभ्रमन् ॥1.162.10॥
1.162.m: In such a land, a certain merchant, through the power of fate, / wandering about having lost his way in the heat, entered the wilderness.

1.162.s:
sa tatra dadṛśe pretānkṣuttṛṣṇāvyākulendriyān ..
utkacānmalinānrūkṣānnirmāṃsānbhīmadarśanān .. 11 ..
1.162.d:
स तत्र ददृशे प्रेतान्क्षुत्तृष्णाव्याकुलेन्द्रियान् ॥
उत्कचान्मलिनान्रूक्षान्निर्मांसान्भीमदर्शनान् ॥ 11 ॥
1.162.m: There he saw pretas whose senses were agitated by hunger and thirst, / with dishevelled hair, filthy, dry, fleshless, and terrible to behold,

1.162.s:
snāyubaddhasthirākāyāndhāvamānānitasstaḥ ..
kañcitsamāṃsaṃ tatraikaṃ pretaskandhagataṃ tadā .. 12 ..
1.162.d:
स्नायुबद्धस्थिराकायान्धावमानानितस्स्तः ॥
कञ्चित्समांसं तत्रैकं प्रेतस्कन्धगतं तदा ॥ 12 ॥
1.162.m: with firm bodies bound by sinews, running here and there. / Then [he saw] one certain [being] endowed with flesh upon the shoulder of a preta,

1.162.s:
dadarśa bahubhiḥ pretaiḥ samantātparivāritam ..
tatskandhādaparaṃ skaṃdhaṃ nīyamānaṃ kramātkamāt ..13..
1.162.d:
ददर्श बहुभिः प्रेतैः समन्तात्परिवारितम् ॥
तत्स्कन्धादपरं स्कंधं नीयमानं क्रमात्कमात् ॥13॥
1.162.m: surrounded on all sides by many pretas, / being carried by turns from one shoulder to another.

1.162.s:
preto'pi dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ghorāmaṭavīṃ naramāgatam ..
pretaskandhānmahīṃ gatvā tasyāntikamupāgamat .. 14 ..
1.162.d:
प्रेतोऽपि दृष्ट्वा तां घोरामटवीं नरमागतम् ॥
प्रेतस्कन्धान्महीं गत्वा तस्यान्तिकमुपागमत् ॥ 14 ॥
1.162.m: The deceased, seeing a man who had entered that dreadful forest, / descended to the earth from the shoulders of the deceased and approached him.

1.162.s:
so'bhivādya vaṇikachreṣṭhamidaṃ vacanamabravīt ..
asminghore mahāraṇye praveśo bhavataḥ katham .. 15 ..
1.162.d:
सोऽभिवाद्य वणिकछ्रेष्ठमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
अस्मिन्घोरे महारण्ये प्रवेशो भवतः कथम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.162.m: Greeting that best of merchants, he spoke these words: / 'How did you enter this terrible, great wilderness?'

1.162.s:
tamuvāca vaṇigdhīmānsārthabhraṣṭasya me vane ..
praveśo daivayogena pūrvakarmakṛtena tu .. 16 ..
1.162.d:
तमुवाच वणिग्धीमान्सार्थभ्रष्टस्य मे वने ॥
प्रवेशो दैवयोगेन पूर्वकर्मकृतेन तु ॥ 16 ॥
1.162.m: The wise merchant said to him: 'Having strayed from my caravan, my entry / into the forest has occurred through the working of fate, brought about by past deeds.

1.162.s:
tṛṣṇā me bādhate'tyarthaṃ kṣutkṣāmaśca bhṛśaṃ tathā ..
prāṇāḥ kaṇṭhamanuprāptā vadanaṃ bhraśyate ca me .. 17 ..
1.162.d:
तृष्णा मे बाधतेऽत्यर्थं क्षुत्क्षामश्च भृशं तथा ॥
प्राणाः कण्ठमनुप्राप्ता वदनं भ्रश्यते च मे ॥ 17 ॥
1.162.m: Thirst torments me exceedingly, and I am utterly wasted with hunger; / my breath has reached my throat, and my mouth is parched.

1.162.s:
atropāyaṃ na paśyāmi dhriye'haṃ yena kena cit ..
ityevamuktaḥ pretastu vaṇijaṃ vākyamabravīt .. 18 ..
1.162.d:
अत्रोपायं न पश्यामि ध्रियेऽहं येन केन चित् ॥
इत्येवमुक्तः प्रेतस्तु वणिजं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥ 18 ॥
1.162.m: I see no means here by which I may somehow be kept alive.' / Addressed in this way, the deceased said these words to the merchant:

1.162.s:
punnāgamimamāśritya pratīkṣasva kṣaṇaṃ mama ..
kṛtātithyo mayā yāvadgamiṣyasi yathāsukham ..19 ..
1.162.d:
पुन्नागमिममाश्रित्य प्रतीक्षस्व क्षणं मम ॥
कृतातिथ्यो मया यावद्गमिष्यसि यथासुखम् ॥19 ॥
1.162.m: 'Relying on this punnāga tree, wait for me a moment, / until, having been received as a guest by me, you may depart at ease.'

1.162.s:
evamuktastadā cakre sa vaṇiktṛṣṇayānvitaḥ ..
madhyāhnasamaye prāpte pretastaṃ deśamāgamat .. 1.162.20 ..
1.162.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा चक्रे स वणिक्तृष्णयान्वितः ॥
मध्याह्नसमये प्राप्ते प्रेतस्तं देशमागमत् ॥ 1.162.20 ॥
1.162.m: Addressed thus, the merchant, filled with thirst, did so then; / when midday arrived, the deceased came to that place,

1.162.s:
punnāgavṛkṣācchītodāṃ vāridhānīṃ manoramām ..
dadhyodanasuyuktena vardhamānena saṃyutām .. 21 ..
1.162.d:
पुन्नागवृक्षाच्छीतोदां वारिधानीं मनोरमाम् ॥
दध्योदनसुयुक्तेन वर्धमानेन संयुताम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.162.m: [bringing] down from the punnāga tree a charming water vessel with cold water, / accompanied by an earthenware platter filled with curd and boiled rice.

1.162.s:
avatārya tatastvagraṃ pradadāti ca yattadā ..
tato'gramātreṇa vaṇikparāṃ tṛptimupāgataḥ .. 22 ..
1.162.d:
अवतार्य ततस्त्वग्रं प्रददाति च यत्तदा ॥
ततोऽग्रमात्रेण वणिक्परां तृप्तिमुपागतः ॥ 22 ॥
1.162.m: Having brought it down, he then gave him the first portion; / from that first portion alone, the merchant attained supreme satisfaction.

1.162.s:
vitṛṣṇo vijvaraścaivaṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata ..
tataḥ preteṣu sarveṣu kramādbhāgaṃ tadā dadau .. 23 ..
1.162.d:
वितृष्णो विज्वरश्चैवं क्षणेन समपद्यत ॥
ततः प्रेतेषु सर्वेषु क्रमाद्भागं तदा ददौ ॥ 23 ॥
1.162.m: Thus, in an instant, he became free of thirst and free of burning fever; / then [the deceased] gave a share in turn to all the deceased.

1.162.s:
dadhyodanātsapānīyātte'pi tṛptiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ ..
atha santarpayitvā tu pretāṃstānsa tu sarvaśaḥ .. 24 ..
1.162.d:
दध्योदनात्सपानीयात्तेऽपि तृप्तिं परां ययुः ॥
अथ सन्तर्पयित्वा तु प्रेतांस्तान्स तु सर्वशः ॥ 24 ॥
1.162.m: From the curd and boiled rice along with water, they too attained supreme satisfaction; / then, having fully gratified those deceased ones on all sides,

1.162.s:
pretādhipaḥ sa bubhuje paścādannaṃ yathāsukham ..
tasya bhuktavatastvannaṃ pānīyaṃ ca kṣayaṃ yayau .. 25 ..
1.162.d:
प्रेताधिपः स बुभुजे पश्चादन्नं यथासुखम् ॥
तस्य भुक्तवतस्त्वन्नं पानीयं च क्षयं ययौ ॥ 25 ॥
1.162.m: that lord of the deceased ate the food afterwards at ease; / when he had eaten, the food and water came to an end.

1.162.s:
pretādhipaṃ tatastṛptaṃ vaṇigvacanamabravīt ..
āścaryametatparamaṃ vane'sminpratibhāti me .. 26 ..
1.162.d:
प्रेताधिपं ततस्तृप्तं वणिग्वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
आश्चर्यमेतत्परमं वनेऽस्मिन्प्रतिभाति मे ॥ 26 ॥
1.162.m: Then the merchant said these words to the satisfied lord of the deceased: / 'This appears to me as a supreme marvel in this forest!

1.162.s:
annapānasya samprāptiḥ paramasya kutastava ..
stokena ca tathānnena bibharṣi ca bahūnkatham .. 27 ..
1.162.d:
अन्नपानस्य सम्प्राप्तिः परमस्य कुतस्तव ॥
स्तोकेन च तथान्नेन बिभर्षि च बहून्कथम् ॥ 27 ॥
1.162.m: Whence comes your attainment of supreme food and drink, / and how do you sustain so many with such little food?

1.162.s:
tṛptā api kathaṃ sarve nirmāṃsā bhinnakukṣayaḥ ..
kaścittvamasyāṃ ghorāyāmaṭavyāṃ tu kṛtālayaḥ .. 28 ..
1.162.d:
तृप्ता अपि कथं सर्वे निर्मांसा भिन्नकुक्षयः ॥
कश्चित्त्वमस्यां घोरायामटव्यां तु कृतालयः ॥ 28 ॥
1.162.m: Why are all of them, though satisfied, fleshless with burst bellies? / And who are you who have made your abode in this dreadful forest?

1.162.s:
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ..
evamuktaḥ sa vaṇijā preto vacanamabravīt .. 29 ..
1.162.d:
एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि परं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥
एवमुक्तः स वणिजा प्रेतो वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ 29 ॥
1.162.m: Dispel this doubt of mine, for my curiosity is great.' / Addressed in this way by the merchant, the deceased spoke these words:

1.162.s:
vāṇijyasaktasya purā kālo 'tīto mamānagha ..
śākale nagare ramye nāstikasya durātmanaḥ .. 1.162.30 ..
1.162.d:
वाणिज्यसक्तस्य पुरा कालो ऽतीतो ममानघ ॥
शाकले नगरे रम्ये नास्तिकस्य दुरात्मनः ॥ 1.162.30 ॥
1.162.m: 'Formerly, blameless one, when devoted to commerce, my time passed / in the delightful city of Śākala as an atheist and an evil-minded man.

1.162.s:
dhanalobhānmayā tatra na kadācidapi prabho ..
dattāsīdbhikṣave bhikṣā kṛpaṇena kathañcana .. 31 ..
1.162.d:
धनलोभान्मया तत्र न कदाचिदपि प्रभो ॥
दत्तासीद्भिक्षवे भिक्षा कृपणेन कथञ्चन ॥ 31 ॥
1.162.m: Out of greed for wealth, O lord, never at any time was alms / given to a beggar by me, miserable as I was, in any manner.

1.162.s:
prātiveśyaśca tatrāsīdbrāhmaṇo guṇavānmama ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tadā .. 32 ..
1.162.d:
प्रातिवेश्यश्च तत्रासीद्ब्राह्मणो गुणवान्मम ॥
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे मासि भाद्रपदे तदा ॥ 32 ॥
1.162.m: I had a neighbor there, a virtuous brahmin; / then, at the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī in the month of Bhādrapada,

1.162.s:
sa kadācinmayā sārdhaṃ tauṣīṃ nāma nadīṃ yayau..
tasyāśca saṅgamaḥ puṇyo yatrāsīccandrabhāgayā ..33..
1.162.d:
स कदाचिन्मया सार्धं तौषीं नाम नदीं ययौ॥
तस्याश्च सङ्गमः पुण्यो यत्रासीच्चन्द्रभागया ॥33॥
1.162.m: he once went with me to the river named Tauṣī, / where its holy confluence with the Candrabhāgā is,

1.162.s:
candrabhāgāsaricchreṣṭhā yatra śītāmalodakā ..
mahādevajaṭājūṭe gaṅgā nipatitā purā ..34..
1.162.d:
चन्द्रभागासरिच्छ्रेष्ठा यत्र शीतामलोदका ॥
महादेवजटाजूटे गङ्गा निपतिता पुरा ॥34॥
1.162.m: where the Candrabhāgā, foremost of rivers, has cold, pure waters; / formerly, Gaṅgā fell onto the matted hair of Mahādeva,

1.162.s:
candreṇa bhāgato nyastā candrabhāgā smṛtā tataḥ ..
tatkālataptasalilā tauṣī tatrārkanandinī .. 35 ..
1.162.d:
चन्द्रेण भागतो न्यस्ता चन्द्रभागा स्मृता ततः ॥
तत्कालतप्तसलिला तौषी तत्रार्कनन्दिनी ॥ 35 ॥
1.162.m: [and part of her] was placed by the moon into a portion (bhāga); hence she is remembered as Candrabhāgā; / there the Tauṣī, daughter of the sun, has waters heated at that time.

1.162.s:
śītoṣṇe codake tasminsaṃgame sumanohare..
taṃ sa deśaṃ samāsādya prātiveśyamasau dvijaḥ..36..
1.162.d:
शीतोष्णे चोदके तस्मिन्संगमे सुमनोहरे॥
तं स देशं समासाद्य प्रातिवेश्यमसौ द्विजः॥36॥
1.162.m: In the cold and hot waters at that most enchanting confluence, / having reached that place, that brahmin neighbor of mine,

1.162.s:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snānārcana upoṣitaḥ..
cāndrabhāgasya toyasya vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā ..37..
1.162.d:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे स्नानार्चन उपोषितः॥
चान्द्रभागस्य तोयस्य वारिधानी नवा दृढा ॥37॥
1.162.m: having fasted for the bathing and worship on the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī, / [gave] a new, sturdy water vessel filled with the water of the Candrabhāgā,

1.162.s:
dadhyodanayutaiḥ sārdhaṃ sampūrṇairvardhamānakaiḥ ..
chatraiścopānahai ramyairvastraiśca vividhairyutā.38..
1.162.d:
दध्योदनयुतैः सार्धं सम्पूर्णैर्वर्धमानकैः ॥
छत्रैश्चोपानहै रम्यैर्वस्त्रैश्च विविधैर्युता.38॥
1.162.m: together with filled earthenware bowls containing curd and boiled rice, / accompanied by delightful umbrellas, shoes, and various garments—

1.162.s:
pradadau vipramukhyebhyo rahasyajño mahīpatiḥ..
cittasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya tasyāpi ca tadā mayā ..39..
1.162.d:
प्रददौ विप्रमुख्येभ्यो रहस्यज्ञो महीपतिः॥
चित्तसंरक्षणार्थाय तस्यापि च तदा मया ॥39॥
1.162.m: the king, knower of secrets, gave [them] to foremost brahmins; / then, for the sake of guarding my [own] mind as well, by me,

1.162.s:
sopavāsena dattaikā vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā..
cāndrabhāgasya toyasya dadhyodanayutā tadā..1.162.40..
1.162.d:
सोपवासेन दत्तैका वारिधानी नवा दृढा॥
चान्द्रभागस्य तोयस्य दध्योदनयुता तदा॥1.162.40॥
1.162.m: fasting, was given one new, sturdy water vessel / of Candrabhāgā water along with curd and boiled rice.

1.162.s:
gatvā gṛhamanuprāpya tataḥ kālena kenacit..
pañcatvamahamāsādya nāstikyātpretatāṃ gataḥ..41..
1.162.d:
गत्वा गृहमनुप्राप्य ततः कालेन केनचित्॥
पञ्चत्वमहमासाद्य नास्तिक्यात्प्रेततां गतः॥41॥
1.162.m: Having returned home, after some time, / I met my death and, because of atheism, became a deceased spirit (preta).

1.162.s:
asyāmaṭavyāṃ ghorāyāṃ yo vā hyakuśalastadā ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge dattā yāsau mayānagha.. .42.
1.162.d:
अस्यामटव्यां घोरायां यो वा ह्यकुशलस्तदा ॥
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे दत्ता यासौ मयानघ॥ .42.
1.162.m: In this dreadful forest, as one who was unskilful at that time, / that which was given by me, blameless one, at the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī—

1.162.s:
dadhyodanayutā ramyā vāridhānī navā dṛḍhā..
seyaṃ madhyāhnasamaye divase divase mama..43..
1.162.d:
दध्योदनयुता रम्या वारिधानी नवा दृढा॥
सेयं मध्याह्नसमये दिवसे दिवसे मम॥43॥
1.162.m: that delightful, new, sturdy water vessel with curd and boiled rice— / it is that which, at the time of midday, day after day,

1.162.s:
upatiṣṭhetsadaiveha yathā dṛṣṭā tvayānagha ..
brahmasvahāriṇastvete pāpāḥ pretatvamāgatāḥ ..44..
1.162.d:
उपतिष्ठेत्सदैवेह यथा दृष्टा त्वयानघ ॥
ब्रह्मस्वहारिणस्त्वेते पापाः प्रेतत्वमागताः ॥44॥
1.162.m: always presents itself here to me, just as seen by you, blameless one. / But these sinful ones who stole brahmins' property have become deceased spirits;

1.162.s:
paridāraratāḥ kecitsvāmidroharatā pare..
mitradroharatāḥ keciddeśe'sminbhṛśadāruṇe..45..
1.162.d:
परिदाररताः केचित्स्वामिद्रोहरता परे॥
मित्रद्रोहरताः केचिद्देशेऽस्मिन्भृशदारुणे॥45॥
1.162.m: some were devoted to other men's wives, others were devoted to treason against their master, / some were devoted to betraying friends in this exceedingly dreadful land.

1.162.s:
mamānuyānaṃ kurvanti annapāna kṛte'nagha ..
akṣayo bhagavānviṣṇuḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ ..46..
1.162.d:
ममानुयानं कुर्वन्ति अन्नपान कृतेऽनघ ॥
अक्षयो भगवान्विष्णुः परमात्मा सनातनः ॥46॥
1.162.m: They follow me, blameless one, for the sake of food and drink; / eternal is the lord Viṣṇu, the supreme soul, everlasting.

1.162.s:
tamuddiśya tu yaddattaṃ tadakṣayyaṃ prakīrtitam..
akṣayyena tathānnena tṛptā api hi mānada .. 47 ..
1.162.d:
तमुद्दिश्य तु यद्दत्तं तदक्षय्यं प्रकीर्तितम्॥
अक्षय्येन तथान्नेन तृप्ता अपि हि मानद ॥ 47 ॥
1.162.m: What is given dedicated to him is proclaimed to be inexhaustible; / yet even though satisfied by such inexhaustible food, O respectful one,

1.162.s:
pretabhāvena daurbalyaṃ na vimuñcanti karhicit ..
ahaṃ ca pūjayitvā tvāmatithiṃ samupasthitam .. 48 ..
1.162.d:
प्रेतभावेन दौर्बल्यं न विमुञ्चन्ति कर्हिचित् ॥
अहं च पूजयित्वा त्वामतिथिं समुपस्थितम् ॥ 48 ॥
1.162.m: they never cast off weakness because of their condition as deceased spirits. / And I, having honored you, a guest who has arrived,

1.162.s:
pretabhāvādvinirmukto yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim ..
mayā vihīnāḥ pretāstu vane'sminbhṛśadāruṇe .. 49 ..
1.162.d:
प्रेतभावाद्विनिर्मुक्तो यास्यामि परमां गतिम् ॥
मया विहीनाः प्रेतास्तु वनेऽस्मिन्भृशदारुणे ॥ 49 ॥
1.162.m: freed from the condition of a deceased spirit, shall attain the highest state; / but the deceased spirits, deprived of me in this exceedingly dreadful forest,

1.162.s:
pīḍāmanubhaviṣyanti dāruṇāṃ karmayogajām..
eteṣāṃ tvaṃ mahābhāga bhadanugrahakāmyayā .. 1.162.50 ..
1.162.d:
पीडामनुभविष्यन्ति दारुणां कर्मयोगजाम्॥
एतेषां त्वं महाभाग भदनुग्रहकाम्यया ॥ 1.162.50 ॥
1.162.m: will experience severe torment born of the working of past deeds. / For their sake, O highly fortunate one, wishing to favor me,

1.162.s:
pratyekaṃ gotranāmāni gṛhṇīṣva likhitena ca ..
asti kakṣyāgataveṣā tava sā pustikā śubhā .. 51 ..
1.162.d:
प्रत्येकं गोत्रनामानि गृह्णीष्व लिखितेन च ॥
अस्ति कक्ष्यागतवेषा तव सा पुस्तिका शुभा ॥ 51 ॥
1.162.m: take down the names and gotras of each one in writing; / that auspicious small booklet is there in your waistband.

1.162.s:
himavantamathāsādya tatra tvaṃ lapsyase nidhim ..
gayāśīrṣe tato gatvā śrāddhaṃ kuru mahāmate ..52..
1.162.d:
हिमवन्तमथासाद्य तत्र त्वं लप्स्यसे निधिम् ॥
गयाशीर्षे ततो गत्वा श्राद्धं कुरु महामते ॥52॥
1.162.m: Then, having reached the Himavat, you will find a treasure there; / going then to Gayāśīrṣa, perform the śrāddha, O highly intelligent one,

1.162.s:
ekaikaṃ tvamathoddiśya pretaṃ pretaṃ yathāsukham ..
tatastu te vimokṣyanti preta bhāvamasaṃśayam .. 53 ..
1.162.d:
एकैकं त्वमथोद्दिश्य प्रेतं प्रेतं यथासुखम् ॥
ततस्तु ते विमोक्ष्यन्ति प्रेत भावमसंशयम् ॥ 53 ॥
1.162.m: designating each individual deceased spirit one by one, at ease; / then they will undoubtedly be released from the condition of deceased spirits.'

1.162.s:
ityevaṃ sa vadanneva taptajāmbūnadaprabhaḥ ..
vimānavaramāsthāya svargalokaṃ tato gataḥ .. 54 ..
1.162.d:
इत्येवं स वदन्नेव तप्तजाम्बूनदप्रभः ॥
विमानवरमास्थाय स्वर्गलोकं ततो गतः ॥ 54 ॥
1.162.m: Even as he was speaking thus, shining with the radiance of melted gold, / he mounted an excellent celestial chariot and went to the world of heaven.

1.162.s:
svarcite pretanāthe tu pretānāṃ sa vaṇikkramāt ..
nāmagotrāṇi saṅgṛhya prayātaḥ sa himālayam .. 55 ..
1.162.d:
स्वर्चिते प्रेतनाथे तु प्रेतानां स वणिक्क्रमात् ॥
नामगोत्राणि सङ्गृह्य प्रयातः स हिमालयम् ॥ 55 ॥
1.162.m: When the lord of the deceased had thus attained heaven, that merchant, in order, / recorded the names and gotras of the deceased and set out for the Himālaya.

1.162.s:
tatra prāpya nidhiṃ gatvā nikṣipya ca tathā gṛhe ..
dhanaṃ kiñcidupādāya gayāśīrṣaṃ tato yayau .. 56 ..
1.162.d:
तत्र प्राप्य निधिं गत्वा निक्षिप्य च तथा गृहे ॥
धनं किञ्चिदुपादाय गयाशीर्षं ततो ययौ ॥ 56 ॥
1.162.m: There, having obtained the treasure, he went and deposited it at home; / taking some wealth, he then went to Gayāśīrṣa.

1.162.s:
pretānāṃ kramaśastatra cakre śrāddhaṃ dinedine ..
yasyayasya yadā śrāddhaṃ karoti sa mahānvaṇik .. 57 ..
1.162.d:
प्रेतानां क्रमशस्तत्र चक्रे श्राद्धं दिनेदिने ॥
यस्ययस्य यदा श्राद्धं करोति स महान्वणिक् ॥ 57 ॥
1.162.m: There, day after day, he performed the śrāddha for the deceased in order; / whenever that great merchant performed the śrāddha for any particular one,

1.162.s:
sasa tasya tadā svapne darśayatyātmanastanum ..
bravīti ca mahābhāga prasādena tavānagha .. 58 ..
1.162.d:
सस तस्य तदा स्वप्ने दर्शयत्यात्मनस्तनुम् ॥
ब्रवीति च महाभाग प्रसादेन तवानघ ॥ 58 ॥
1.162.m: that one would then show his form to him in a dream / and say: 'O highly fortunate, blameless one, by your grace!'

1.162.s:
pretabhāvo mayā tyaktaḥ prāpto'smi tridivaṃ dhuvam ..
kṛtvā sa dhanadānena pretānāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ vaṇik .. 59 ..
1.162.d:
प्रेतभावो मया त्यक्तः प्राप्तोऽस्मि त्रिदिवं धुवम् ॥
कृत्वा स धनदानेन प्रेतानां निष्कृतिं वणिक् ॥ 59 ॥
1.162.m: "I have abandoned the state of a deceased spirit and have surely reached heaven." / Having thus accomplished the release of the deceased spirits by gifts of wealth, that merchant

1.162.s:
jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatra māsi bhādrapade tadā ..
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayitvā janārdanam .. 1.162.60 ..
1.162.d:
जगाम स्वगृहं तत्र मासि भाद्रपदे तदा ॥
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे पूजयित्वा जनार्दनम् ॥ 1.162.60 ॥
1.162.m: went to his own home. Then, in the month of Bhādrapada, / having worshiped Janārdana at the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī,

1.162.s:
dhanaṃ ca dattvā viprebhyaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
puṇyeṣu satataṃ rājannadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca ..61..
1.162.d:
धनं च दत्त्वा विप्रेभ्यः सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥
पुण्येषु सततं राजन्नदीनां सङ्गमेषु च ॥61॥
1.162.m: and having given wealth to the brahmins, fasting and with senses controlled, / constantly at the sacred confluences of rivers, O king:

1.162.s:
gaṅgāsarayvorgaṅgāyāḥ śoṇasya ca mahāmatiḥ ..
ikṣumatyāśca gaṅgāyā gaṅgāyamunayostathā .. 62 ..
1.162.d:
गङ्गासरय्वोर्गङ्गायाः शोणस्य च महामतिः ॥
इक्षुमत्याश्च गङ्गाया गङ्गायमुनयोस्तथा ॥ 62 ॥
1.162.m: of the Gaṅgā and the Sarayū, and of the Gaṅgā and the Śoṇa, the wise man; / of the Ikṣumatī and the Gaṅgā, and likewise of the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā;

1.162.s:
gomatyāśca sarayvāśca kauśikīgaṇḍakyostathā ..
vipāśayā devahradā yatra yogaṃ prapadyate .. 63 ..
1.162.d:
गोमत्याश्च सरय्वाश्च कौशिकीगण्डक्योस्तथा ॥
विपाशया देवह्रदा यत्र योगं प्रपद्यते ॥ 63 ॥
1.162.m: of the Gomatī and the Sarayū, and likewise of the Kauśikī and the Gaṇḍakī; / where the Devahrada joins with the Vipāśā;

1.162.s:
vipāśā ca tathā yogaṃ yatra yāti śatadruṇā ..
irāvatī tathā yogaṃ yatra vrajati sindhunā .. 64 ..
1.162.d:
विपाशा च तथा योगं यत्र याति शतद्रुणा ॥
इरावती तथा योगं यत्र व्रजति सिन्धुना ॥ 64 ॥
1.162.m: and where the Vipāśā joins with the Śatadru; / where the Irāvatī joins with the Sindhu;

1.162.s:
candrabhāgā ca vrajati yatra yogaṃ vitastayā ..
mahāsindhuśca saṃyogaṃ yatra yāti vitastayā .. 65 ..
1.162.d:
चन्द्रभागा च व्रजति यत्र योगं वितस्तया ॥
महासिन्धुश्च संयोगं यत्र याति वितस्तया ॥ 65 ॥
1.162.m: and where the Candrabhāgā joins with the Vitastā; / and where the great Sindhu joins with the Vitastā—

1.162.s:
pratyabdaṃ yāvadeteṣu saṃgameṣu mahāvaṇik ..
karoti vidhivaddānaṃ yāvaddiṣṭāntamāgataḥ .. 66 ..
1.162.d:
प्रत्यब्दं यावदेतेषु संगमेषु महावणिक् ॥
करोति विधिवद्दानं यावद्दिष्टान्तमागतः ॥ 66 ॥
1.162.m: every year, at these confluences, the great merchant / made gifts according to rule, until he reached the end of his appointed lifespan.

1.162.s:
avāpa paramaṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ yattu jantubhiḥ ..
yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ .. 67 ..
1.162.d:
अवाप परमं स्थानं दुर्लभं यत्तु जन्तुभिः ॥
यत्र कामफला वृक्षा नद्यः पायसकर्दमाः ॥ 67 ॥
1.162.m: He attained the supreme realm, which is difficult for living beings to reach, / where the trees yield every wish and the rivers have milk-rice for mud,

1.162.s:
śītalāmalapānīyāḥ puṣkariṇyo manoharāḥ ..
suvarṇasikatā rājanmaṇisopānabhūṣitāḥ ..68..
1.162.d:
शीतलामलपानीयाः पुष्करिण्यो मनोहराः ॥
सुवर्णसिकता राजन्मणिसोपानभूषिताः ॥68॥
1.162.m: with charming lotus-ponds of cool, pure water, / having golden sands, O king, and adorned with jewelled steps.

1.162.s:
ānantyāya sa saṃprāpto deśaṃ taṃ bhūridakṣiṇaḥ ..
taṃ deśamāsādya vaṇiṅmahātmā sutaptajāmbūnadabhūṣitāṅgaḥ ..
kalpaṃ samagraṃ mudito yadātmā reme sa rāmābhiyutaḥ kṛtātmā .. 69 ..
1.162.d:
आनन्त्याय स संप्राप्तो देशं तं भूरिदक्षिणः ॥
तं देशमासाद्य वणिङ्महात्मा सुतप्तजाम्बूनदभूषिताङ्गः ॥
कल्पं समग्रं मुदितो यदात्मा रेमे स रामाभियुतः कृतात्मा ॥ 69 ॥
1.162.m: He reached that realm for eternity, having given abundant sacrificial fees. / Having reached that realm, the noble merchant, his limbs adorned with well-refined gold, / delighted, his mind at peace, sporting with beautiful women, his self perfected, rejoiced for an entire aeon.

1.162.s:
vimānairapsarobhiśca siddhagandharvasevitaḥ ..
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam..1.162.70..
1.162.d:
विमानैरप्सरोभिश्च सिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितः ॥
विष्णुलोकमवाप्नोति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम्॥1.162.70॥
1.162.m: Attended by celestial cars and Apsarases, and served by Siddhas and Gandharvas, / he attains the world of Viṣṇu until the dissolution of all beings.

1.162.s:
rājasūyādibhiryajñairyatphalaṃ samavāpyate ..
śravaṇadvādaśīṃ kṛtvā tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ..71..
1.162.d:
राजसूयादिभिर्यज्ञैर्यत्फलं समवाप्यते ॥
श्रवणद्वादशीं कृत्वा तत्फलं लभते नरः॥71॥
1.162.m: Whatever fruit is obtained through sacrifices such as the Rājasūya, / a man obtains that fruit by observing Śravaṇadvādaśī.

1.163.s:
vajra uvāca..
ekāmupoṣya kṛṣṇāṃ yāṃ dvādaśīṃ vidhinā naraḥ ..
mahatphalamavāpnoti tāṃ samācakṣva bhārgava ..1 ..
1.163.d:
वज्र उवाच॥
एकामुपोष्य कृष्णां यां द्वादशीं विधिना नरः ॥
महत्फलमवाप्नोति तां समाचक्ष्व भार्गव ॥1 ॥
1.163.m: Vajra said: / Having fasted according to rule on which single dark Dvādaśī / does a man obtain great fruit? Describe that, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

1.163.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pauṣyāntu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā ..
dvādaśī yā bhavetkṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī .. 2 ..
1.163.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पौष्यान्तु समतीतायां श्रवणेन तु संयुता ॥
द्वादशी या भवेत्कृष्णा प्रोक्ता सा तिलद्वादशी ॥ 2 ॥
1.163.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the full moon of Pauṣa has passed, the dark Dvādaśī / that is joined with Śravaṇa is called Tiladvādaśī.

1.163.s:
tilaiḥ snānaṃ tilairhomaṃ naivedyaṃ tilamodakaiḥ ..
dīpāśca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakam .. 3 ..
1.163.d:
तिलैः स्नानं तिलैर्होमं नैवेद्यं तिलमोदकैः ॥
दीपाश्च तिलतैलेन तथा देयं तिलोदकम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.163.m: Bathing with sesame seeds, offering sesame seeds into the fire, food offering with sesame-seed sweets, / lamps with sesame oil, and likewise water with sesame seeds should be offered.

1.163.s:
tilāśca deyā viprebhyastasminnahani pārthiva ..
upavāsadine rājanhotavyāśca tathā tilāḥ .. 4 ..
1.163.d:
तिलाश्च देया विप्रेभ्यस्तस्मिन्नहनि पार्थिव ॥
उपवासदिने राजन्होतव्याश्च तथा तिलाः ॥ 4 ॥
1.163.m: Sesame seeds should be given to brahmins on that day, O ruler of the earth. / On the day of fasting, O king, sesame seeds must also be offered into the fire.

1.163.s:
upoṣitenāpare'hni hotavyāśca viśeṣataḥ ..
indhanaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyastathā'nagha ..5..
1.163.d:
उपोषितेनापरेऽह्नि होतव्याश्च विशेषतः ॥
इन्धनं च प्रदातव्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तथाऽनघ ॥5॥
1.163.m: By one who has fasted, they must especially be offered into the fire on the following day. / Firewood should also be given to brahmins, O sinless one.

1.163.s:
tilaprasthaṃ tadā hutvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ..
na durgatimavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..6 ..
1.163.d:
तिलप्रस्थं तदा हुत्वा सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥
न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥6 ॥
1.163.m: Then, having offered a prastha of sesame seeds into the fire, fasting and with senses controlled, / he does not go to a bad state; no doubt should be entertained on this matter.

1.163.s:
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ homamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
pauruṣaṃ ca tā sūktaṃ śrīsūktena ca saṃyutama..7..
1.163.d:
तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं होममन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
पौरुषं च ता सूक्तं श्रीसूक्तेन च संयुतम॥7॥
1.163.m: "Tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam" is proclaimed as the mantra for the fire offering, / and the Puruṣasūkta combined with the Śrīsūkta.

1.163.s:
homaḥ kāryo'tha rājendra sāvitryā ca yatātmanā ..
etatproktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ strīśūdreṣu tathā śṛṇu .. 8 ..
1.163.d:
होमः कार्योऽथ राजेन्द्र सावित्र्या च यतात्मना ॥
एतत्प्रोक्तं द्विजातीनां स्त्रीशूद्रेषु तथा शृणु ॥ 8 ॥
1.163.m: The fire offering should then be performed with the Sāvitrī by one who is self-controlled, O king of kings. / This is declared for the twice-born. Now hear concerning women and śūdras.

1.163.s:
dvādaśāṣṭākṣaro maṃtrasteṣāṃ prokto mahātmanām ..
hitau tau ca dvijātīnāṃ mantraśreṣṭhau narādhipa .. 9 ..
1.163.d:
द्वादशाष्टाक्षरो मंत्रस्तेषां प्रोक्तो महात्मनाम् ॥
हितौ तौ च द्विजातीनां मन्त्रश्रेष्ठौ नराधिप ॥ 9 ॥
1.163.m: A twelve-syllabled and an eight-syllabled mantra are declared for those noble ones. / Those two supreme mantras are also beneficial for the twice-born, O lord of men.

1.163.s:
tābhyāmabhyadhiko mantro vidyate neha kutracit ..
vajra uvāca ..
dvādaśāṣṭākṣarau mantrau kathayasva mamānagha .. 1.163.10 ..
1.163.d:
ताभ्यामभ्यधिको मन्त्रो विद्यते नेह कुत्रचित् ॥
वज्र उवाच ॥
द्वादशाष्टाक्षरौ मन्त्रौ कथयस्व ममानघ ॥ 1.163.10 ॥
1.163.m: There is no mantra superior to these two anywhere in this world. / Vajra said: / Tell me the twelve-syllabled and eight-syllabled mantras, O sinless one,

1.163.s:
puṇyau pavitrau maṅgalyau sarvapāpapraṇāśanau ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya..
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya .. 11 ..
1.163.d:
पुण्यौ पवित्रौ मङ्गल्यौ सर्वपापप्रणाशनौ ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ओं नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय॥
ओं नमो नारायणाय ॥ 11 ॥
1.163.m: meritorious, purifying, auspicious, destroyers of all sins. / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / "Oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya." / "Oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya."

1.163.s:
etau mayā te kathitau pavitrau mantrottamau pāpaharau vareṇyau ..
pārāyaṇau sarvatapasvināṃ ca rahasyabhūtau bhuvaneṣu nityam .. 12 ..
1.163.d:
एतौ मया ते कथितौ पवित्रौ मन्त्रोत्तमौ पापहरौ वरेण्यौ ॥
पारायणौ सर्वतपस्विनां च रहस्यभूतौ भुवनेषु नित्यम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.163.m: These two purifying, excellent mantras, destroyers of sin, most worthy of choice, / have been told to you by me; they are the ultimate refuge of all ascetics and are forever a secret in the worlds.

1.163.s:
yathā tithiste śravaṇena yuktā māghasya māsasya tathā tavoktā ..
kāryā tatheyaṃ nṛpate viśeṣādyoge pavitre saritordvayasya .. 13 ..
1.163.d:
यथा तिथिस्ते श्रवणेन युक्ता माघस्य मासस्य तथा तवोक्ता ॥
कार्या तथेयं नृपते विशेषाद्योगे पवित्रे सरितोर्द्वयस्य ॥ 13 ॥
1.163.m: Just as the lunar day joined with Śravaṇa in the month of Māgha has been told to you, / so this must especially be observed, O king, at the sacred confluence of two rivers.

1.164.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
māgadheṣu tu yadvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 1 ..
1.164.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥
मागधेषु तु यद्वृत्तं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप ॥ 1 ॥
1.164.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On this subject, they also cite this ancient legendary account. / Hear what happened among the Magadhas, O lord of men.

1.164.s:
babhūva māgadho rājā caṇḍavega iti śrutaḥ ..
tasyāsīdrūpasaṃpannā bhāryā nayanasundarī .. 2 ..
1.164.d:
बभूव मागधो राजा चण्डवेग इति श्रुतः ॥
तस्यासीद्रूपसंपन्ना भार्या नयनसुन्दरी ॥ 2 ॥
1.164.m: There was a king of Magadha renowned as Caṇḍavega. / He had a wife endowed with beauty named Nayanasundarī.

1.164.s:
sarvadharmānparityajya pratasaṃvatsaraṃ tu sā ..
tilānhomayate viprairjuhoti ca tathā svayam .. 3 ..
1.164.d:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य प्रतसंवत्सरं तु सा ॥
तिलान्होमयते विप्रैर्जुहोति च तथा स्वयम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.164.m: Abandoning all other religious practices, every year / she had brahmins offer sesame seeds into the fire, and also offered them herself,

1.164.s:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māghe māsi hutāśane ..
devasya caiva naivedyaṃ karoti tilamodakaiḥ .. 4 ..
1.164.d:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे माघे मासि हुताशने ॥
देवस्य चैव नैवेद्यं करोति तिलमोदकैः ॥ 4 ॥
1.164.m: at the conjunction of Śravaṇadvādaśī in the month of Māgha, into the fire, / and made a food offering of sesame-seed sweets to the god.

1.164.s:
arcanena ca vāsobhiḥ pūjayatyapi mādhavam ..
mahārañjitaraktāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca .. 5 ..
1.164.d:
अर्चनेन च वासोभिः पूजयत्यपि माधवम् ॥
महारञ्जितरक्तानि वासांसि विविधानि च ॥ 5 ॥
1.164.m: She worshiped Mādhava with offerings and garments, / and diverse garments dyed deep red with safflower

1.164.s:
brāhmaṇīnāṃ ca geheṣu visarjayati tatparā ..
mahāvartipradānaṃ ca vidhatte keśavālaye .. 6 ..
1.164.d:
ब्राह्मणीनां च गेहेषु विसर्जयति तत्परा ॥
महावर्तिप्रदानं च विधत्ते केशवालये ॥ 6 ॥
1.164.m: she distributed in the houses of brahmin women, intent on this practice; / and she presented large wicks in the temple of Keśava.

1.164.s:
tāṃ kadācitsukhāsīnāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ tu vasantikā ..
papraccha sakhibhāvena rahasyaṃ nirjane sthitā .. 7 ..
1.164.d:
तां कदाचित्सुखासीनां ब्राह्मणीं तु वसन्तिका ॥
पप्रच्छ सखिभावेन रहस्यं निर्जने स्थिता ॥ 7 ॥
1.164.m: Once, when she was sitting comfortably, a brahmin woman named Vasantikā / approached her in solitary seclusion and asked her out of friendship about the secret.

1.164.s:
vasantikovāca ..
sarvadharmānparityajya māghe māsi śubhānane ..
dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya kasmādarcayase harim .. 8 ..
1.164.d:
वसन्तिकोवाच ॥
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य माघे मासि शुभानने ॥
द्वादश्यां कृष्णपक्षस्य कस्मादर्चयसे हरिम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.164.m: Vasantikā said: / Setting aside all other dharmas, O fair-faced woman, in the month of Māgha, / on the Dvādaśī of the dark fortnight, why do you worship Hari?

1.164.s:
kasmāttathā bahutilaṃ hāvayasyanale tathā ..
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi rahasyaṃ cenna te śubhe .. 9 ..
1.164.d:
कस्मात्तथा बहुतिलं हावयस्यनले तथा ॥
एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि रहस्यं चेन्न ते शुभे ॥ 9 ॥
1.164.m: And why do you offer so many sesame seeds into the fire? / Dispel this doubt of mine, if it is not a secret from me, O fair one.

1.164.s:
nayanasundaryuvāca ..
rahasyametatparamaṃ na rahasyaṃ tathā tvayi ..
tvaṃ me sakhīśvarī prāṇastvaṃ me prāṇadhaneśvarī .. 1.164.10 ..
1.164.d:
नयनसुन्दर्युवाच ॥
रहस्यमेतत्परमं न रहस्यं तथा त्वयि ॥
त्वं मे सखीश्वरी प्राणस्त्वं मे प्राणधनेश्वरी ॥ 1.164.10 ॥
1.164.m: Nayanasundarī said: / This is a supreme secret, yet it is no secret from you. / You are my friend and mistress, my very life-breath; you are the mistress of my life and wealth.

1.164.s:
asti vaitastiko nāma deśaḥ paramadhāmikaḥ ..
tatra grāmavaraṃ cāsīdvasatirme suśobhanā .. 11 ..
1.164.d:
अस्ति वैतस्तिको नाम देशः परमधामिकः ॥
तत्र ग्रामवरं चासीद्वसतिर्मे सुशोभना ॥ 11 ॥
1.164.m: There is a most righteous region named Vaitastika. / In that region was an excellent village where I had a very lovely dwelling.

1.164.s:
caṇḍavegaśca vipro'bhūdbhartā me pūrvajanmani ..
nāstiko niranukrośastarkaśāstrarataḥ sadā ..12..
1.164.d:
चण्डवेगश्च विप्रोऽभूद्भर्ता मे पूर्वजन्मनि ॥
नास्तिको निरनुक्रोशस्तर्कशास्त्ररतः सदा ॥12॥
1.164.m: Caṇḍavega was a brahmin, my husband in a previous birth, / an atheist, uncompassionate, and always devoted to logic.

1.164.s:
tatraiva viṣaye rājā babhūva dadhivāhanaḥ ..
tasya bhāryāṃ vayasyā me babhūva kamalā śubhā .. 13 ..
1.164.d:
तत्रैव विषये राजा बभूव दधिवाहनः ॥
तस्य भार्यां वयस्या मे बभूव कमला शुभा ॥ 13 ॥
1.164.m: In that very realm, there was a king named Dadhivāhana. / His wife, the auspicious Kamalā, was my companion.

1.164.s:
sā kadācinmāmuvāca rahasyaṃ varavarṇinī ..
nārī bhartṛkṛtādardhaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti sundarī .. 14 ..
1.164.d:
सा कदाचिन्मामुवाच रहस्यं वरवर्णिनी ॥
नारी भर्तृकृतादर्धं पुण्यं प्राप्नोति सुन्दरी ॥ 14 ॥
1.164.m: Once, that fair woman spoke to me in secret: / 'A woman receives half the merit produced by her husband, O beautiful one.

1.164.s:
nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthagyajño na vrataṃ nāpyupoṣitam ..
patiṃ śuśrūṣate yā tu tena svarge mahīyate .. 15 ..
1.164.d:
नास्ति स्त्रीणां पृथग्यज्ञो न व्रतं नाप्युपोषितम् ॥
पतिं शुश्रूषते या तु तेन स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ 15 ॥
1.164.m: Women have no separate sacrifice, no vow, and no fasting; / but she who attends upon her husband is glorified in heaven on that account.

1.164.s:
kartavyaṃ yoṣitā puṇyaṃ pṛthagvāpi tadicchayā ..
patiste nāstiko bhadre kiñcinnācarate śubham .. 16 ..
1.164.d:
कर्तव्यं योषिता पुण्यं पृथग्वापि तदिच्छया ॥
पतिस्ते नास्तिको भद्रे किञ्चिन्नाचरते शुभम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.164.m: Merit may be performed by a woman separately only with his consent; / but your husband is an atheist, my dear, and performs nothing good.

1.164.s:
na cācarasi dharmaṃ tvaṃ tathā ca tadanujñayā ..
kā gatiḥ paraloke te bhaviṣyati śubhānane ..17..
1.164.d:
न चाचरसि धर्मं त्वं तथा च तदनुज्ञया ॥
का गतिः परलोके ते भविष्यति शुभानने ॥17॥
1.164.m: Nor do you practice dharma, even with his permission; / what state will be yours in the next world, O lovely-faced one?

1.164.s:
iha yatkriyate karma pretya tatropabhujyate ..
yenoptaṃ phalakāle tu sa evāśnāti bhāmini .. 18 ..
1.164.d:
इह यत्क्रियते कर्म प्रेत्य तत्रोपभुज्यते ॥
येनोप्तं फलकाले तु स एवाश्नाति भामिनि ॥ 18 ॥
1.164.m: Whatever deed is done here is enjoyed after death in that [other] world; / whoever has sown, he alone eats at the time of fruit, O spirited lady.

1.164.s:
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya vidyutsampātacañcalam ..
nācaranti śubhaṃ ye tu teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam .. 19 ..
1.164.d:
मानुष्यं दुर्लभं प्राप्य विद्युत्सम्पातचञ्चलम् ॥
नाचरन्ति शुभं ये तु तेषां जन्म निरर्थकम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.164.m: Having obtained human birth, which is rare to obtain and unsteady like a flash of lightning, / those who do not perform good have lived their life in vain.

1.164.s:
kadācidapi vāmoru yoniṣvatha paribhraman ..
mānuṣyaṃ nāma jāyeta yatrāyattaṃ śubhāśubham .. .. 1.164.20 .
1.164.d:
कदाचिदपि वामोरु योनिष्वथ परिभ्रमन् ॥
मानुष्यं नाम जायेत यत्रायत्तं शुभाशुभम् ॥ ॥ 1.164.20 ।
1.164.m: Only on occasion, O beautiful-thighed one, while wandering through wombs, / does one take birth as a human, upon which good and evil depend.

1.164.s:
caṇḍālatve'pi mānuṣyaṃ sarvathā sakhi durlabham ..
ātmā śakyastayā trātuṃ mānuṣyānnānyataḥ śubhe .. 21 ..
1.164.d:
चण्डालत्वेऽपि मानुष्यं सर्वथा सखि दुर्लभम् ॥
आत्मा शक्यस्तया त्रातुं मानुष्यान्नान्यतः शुभे ॥ 21 ॥
1.164.m: Even in the state of an outcast, human birth is exceedingly rare, my friend; / the self can be rescued through human birth, not through anything else, O auspicious one.

1.164.s:
tavopari tathā jātā sakhī bhāvena me kṛpā ..
kadaryyasyāsya bhāryā tvaṃ susvabhāvā pativratā .. 22 ..
1.164.d:
तवोपरि तथा जाता सखी भावेन मे कृपा ॥
कदर्य्यस्यास्य भार्या त्वं सुस्वभावा पतिव्रता ॥ 22 ॥
1.164.m: Therefore, out of friendship, compassion has arisen in me towards you; / you are the wife of this miser, yet of good nature and devoted to your husband.

1.164.s:
tatra te'nugrahaṃ kiñcitkariṣyāmi nibodha tat ..
harasya dayitā bhāryā śailendratanayā umā .. 23 ..
1.164.d:
तत्र तेऽनुग्रहं किञ्चित्करिष्यामि निबोध तत् ॥
हरस्य दयिता भार्या शैलेन्द्रतनया उमा ॥ 23 ॥
1.164.m: Therefore, I shall bestow a favor upon you; listen to it: / Hara's beloved wife is Umā, daughter of the king of mountains.

1.164.s:
vistāritamahākūlā sā vitastā mahānadī ..
avṛttikarṣitaḥ pāpaṃ kṛtvaiva ṛtupañcakam .. 24 ..
1.164.d:
विस्तारितमहाकूला सा वितस्ता महानदी ॥
अवृत्तिकर्षितः पापं कृत्वैव ऋतुपञ्चकम् ॥ 24 ॥
1.164.m: She became the great river Vitastā with its wide, vast banks. / Even if one, worn down by lack of livelihood, has committed sin for five seasons,

1.164.s:
snānenaikena sakalaṃ śaiśireṇa vyapohati ..
yasyāṃ yasyāṃ tithau snātaḥ svargamāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 25 ..
1.164.d:
स्नानेनैकेन सकलं शैशिरेण व्यपोहति ॥
यस्यां यस्यां तिथौ स्नातः स्वर्गमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.164.m: he wipes it all away by a single winter bath. / On whatever lunar day one bathes in her, he attains heaven without a doubt.

1.164.s:
tasyāṃ samvatsaraṃ snātvā mokṣopāyaṃ tu vindati ..
yā ca susvādusalilā yā ca pāpakṣayaṅkarī .. 26 ..
1.164.d:
तस्यां सम्वत्सरं स्नात्वा मोक्षोपायं तु विन्दति ॥
या च सुस्वादुसलिला या च पापक्षयङ्करी ॥ 26 ॥
1.164.m: And having bathed in her for a year, one discovers the means to liberation. / Her waters are very sweet and she destroys sins.

1.164.s:
tasyāstīre mayā nityaṃ prati samvatsaraṃ śubhe ..
upoṣya māghakṛṣṇasya dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe tathā .. 27 ..
1.164.d:
तस्यास्तीरे मया नित्यं प्रति सम्वत्सरं शुभे ॥
उपोष्य माघकृष्णस्य द्वादश्यां श्रवणे तथा ॥ 27 ॥
1.164.m: On her bank every year, O auspicious one, / having fasted on the twelfth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha under the asterism Śravaṇa,

1.164.s:
pūjito bhagavānviṣṇurbrāhmaṇāśca hutāśanaḥ ..
tilaistasmāttu te khyātaṃ brāhmametadvrataṃ mama ..28 ..
1.164.d:
पूजितो भगवान्विष्णुर्ब्राह्मणाश्च हुताशनः ॥
तिलैस्तस्मात्तु ते ख्यातं ब्राह्ममेतद्व्रतं मम ॥28 ॥
1.164.m: the blessed Viṣṇu, the brahmins, and the fire were worshipped by me / with sesame seeds; therefore, this sacred vow of mine is celebrated for you.

1.164.s:
tasmātskannaṃ tilaṃ yacca yadagnau patitaṃ na ca ..
tataḥ puṇyaphalaṃ sarvaṃ tvamāpnuhi varānane .. 29 ..
1.164.d:
तस्मात्स्कन्नं तिलं यच्च यदग्नौ पतितं न च ॥
ततः पुण्यफलं सर्वं त्वमाप्नुहि वरानने ॥ 29 ॥
1.164.m: Whatever sesame fell aside and did not fall into the fire, / may you obtain all the meritorious fruit from that, O lovely-faced one!'

1.164.s:
ityevamuktayā gatvā bhartā pṛṣṭastadā mayā ..
hasatā tena cāsmyuktā gaccha gṛhṇīṣva tatphalam .. 1.164.30 ..
1.164.d:
इत्येवमुक्तया गत्वा भर्ता पृष्टस्तदा मया ॥
हसता तेन चास्म्युक्ता गच्छ गृह्णीष्व तत्फलम् ॥ 1.164.30 ॥
1.164.m: Having been spoken to in this way, I went and asked my husband then; / laughing, he said to me: 'Go and take that fruit.'

1.164.s:
svayaṃ kṛtvā śubhaṃ karma kamalā sā sakhī mama ..
saha bhartrā viśālākṣi viṣṇulokamito gatā .. 31 ..
1.164.d:
स्वयं कृत्वा शुभं कर्म कमला सा सखी मम ॥
सह भर्त्रा विशालाक्षि विष्णुलोकमितो गता ॥ 31 ॥
1.164.m: Having performed that good deed herself, my friend Kamalā, / along with her husband, O large-eyed one, went from here to the world of Viṣṇu.

1.164.s:
tallokamakṣayaṃ tasyāḥ śrutaṃ vaivasvatānmayā ..
tasmāddṛṣṭaphalaṃ bhadre karomi tiladvādaśīm .. 32 ..
1.164.d:
तल्लोकमक्षयं तस्याः श्रुतं वैवस्वतान्मया ॥
तस्माद्दृष्टफलं भद्रे करोमि तिलद्वादशीम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.164.m: I heard from Vaivasvata that her world is imperishable; / therefore, seeing its fruit, O gentle lady, I observe the Tiladvādaśī.

1.164.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ pṛcchasi sundari ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ brāhmaṇyapi vasantikā .. 33 ..
1.164.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां पृच्छसि सुन्दरि ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं ब्राह्मण्यपि वसन्तिका ॥ 33 ॥
1.164.m: All this has been related to you which you ask of me, O beautiful one.' / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having heard this auspicious speech, the brahmin woman Vasantikā also,

1.164.s:
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayāmāsa keśavam ..
māghakṛṣṇe mahābhāga tilairnityamatandritā .. 34 ..
1.164.d:
श्रवणद्वादशीयोगे पूजयामास केशवम् ॥
माघकृष्णे महाभाग तिलैर्नित्यमतन्द्रिता ॥ 34 ॥
1.164.m: at the conjunction of Śravaṇa and the twelfth lunar day / in the dark fortnight of Māgha, O fortunate one, constantly worshipped Keśava with sesame seeds, free from sloth.

1.164.s:
pūjayitvāpi sā devaṃ śvetadvīpamito gatā ..
sāpi rājño mahābhāgā tathā nayanasundarī .. 35 ..
1.164.d:
पूजयित्वापि सा देवं श्वेतद्वीपमितो गता ॥
सापि राज्ञो महाभागा तथा नयनसुन्दरी ॥ 35 ॥
1.164.m: Having worshipped the god, she went from here to Śvetadvīpa; / and the fortunate [queen] Nayanasundarī, the wife of the king,

1.164.s:
amalaṃ sthānamāsādya virarāja śaśiprabhā ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tadā pūjyo janārdanaḥ .. 36 ..
1.164.d:
अमलं स्थानमासाद्य विरराज शशिप्रभा ॥
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तदा पूज्यो जनार्दनः ॥ 36 ॥
1.164.m: having attained that spotless realm, shone with the luster of the moon. / Therefore, with all effort, Janārdana should be worshipped at that time,

1.164.s:
tilairnityaṃ mahābhāga hotavyāśca tathā tilāḥ ..
tilāśca deyā viprebhyastasminnahani pārthiva .. 37 .
1.164.d:
तिलैर्नित्यं महाभाग होतव्याश्च तथा तिलाः ॥
तिलाश्च देया विप्रेभ्यस्तस्मिन्नहनि पार्थिव ॥ 37 ।
1.164.m: constantly with sesame seeds, O fortunate one, and sesame seeds should be offered into the fire, / and sesame seeds should be given to brahmins on that day, O ruler of the earth.

1.164.s:
ekaikasmāttilādrājaṃstilabījodbhave yathā ..
sukṛṣṭakṣetrajāddṛṣṭaṃ deve kālapravarṣiṇi .. 38 ..
1.164.d:
एकैकस्मात्तिलाद्राजंस्तिलबीजोद्भवे यथा ॥
सुकृष्टक्षेत्रजाद्दृष्टं देवे कालप्रवर्षिणि ॥ 38 ॥
1.164.m: Just as from a single sesame seed, O king, there is the growth of sesame seeds, / as seen when springing from a well-ploughed field when the rain falls in due season,

1.164.s:
ekaikasmāttilāttadvatphalamakṣayyamaśnute ..
svarloke viṣṇuloke vā mānuṣye yadi vā nṛpa ..
akṣayyaṃ phalamāpnoti ekaikasmāttilāttilāt .. 39 ..
1.164.d:
एकैकस्मात्तिलात्तद्वत्फलमक्षय्यमश्नुते ॥
स्वर्लोके विष्णुलोके वा मानुष्ये यदि वा नृप ॥
अक्षय्यं फलमाप्नोति एकैकस्मात्तिलात्तिलात् ॥ 39 ॥
1.164.m: so from each single sesame seed one enjoys imperishable fruit; / whether in heaven, or in the world of Viṣṇu, or in human birth, O king, / one obtains imperishable fruit from every single sesame seed.

1.164.s:
tasmātprayatnena narendracandra tasyā samabhyarcaya vāsudevam ..
upoṣitaḥ prītamanā yathāvattrāṇaṃ sa devaḥ prathito narāṇām .. 1.164.40 ..
1.164.d:
तस्मात्प्रयत्नेन नरेन्द्रचन्द्र तस्या समभ्यर्चय वासुदेवम् ॥
उपोषितः प्रीतमना यथावत्त्राणं स देवः प्रथितो नराणाम् ॥ 1.164.40 ॥
1.164.m: Therefore, with effort, O moon among kings, properly worship Vāsudeva on that day, / having fasted, with a delighted mind; that god is celebrated as the protector of men.

1.165.s:
.. vajra uvāca ..
hotavye viṣṇudaivatye sāvitrī me tvayoditā ..
homakarmaṇi sandeho mahānme bhṛgunandana .. 1 ..
1.165.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
होतव्ये विष्णुदैवत्ये सावित्री मे त्वयोदिता ॥
होमकर्मणि सन्देहो महान्मे भृगुनन्दन ॥ 1 ॥
1.165.m: Vajra said: / The Sāvitrī was declared by you to me for the oblation to be made to the deity Viṣṇu; / concerning the rite of the fire sacrifice, I have a great doubt, O son of Bhṛgu.

1.165.s:
savitā daivataṃ tasyāḥ sāvitrītyucyate tataḥ ..
tayā kathaṃ tu kartavyaṃ homakarma ca vaiṣṇavam .. 2 ..
1.165.d:
सविता दैवतं तस्याः सावित्रीत्युच्यते ततः ॥
तया कथं तु कर्तव्यं होमकर्म च वैष्णवम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.165.m: Savitṛ is its deity, and therefore it is called Sāvitrī; / how then can a Vaiṣṇava fire-sacrifice rite be performed with it?

1.165.s:
prabhāvamārṣeśca tathā tasyāstvaṃ mama kīrtaya ..
vedamātā tu sā proktā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ..3..
1.165.d:
प्रभावमार्षेश्च तथा तस्यास्त्वं मम कीर्तय ॥
वेदमाता तु सा प्रोक्ता सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी ॥3॥
1.165.m: Tell me also of the power and the seer of that [verse]; / for she is declared to be the mother of the Vedas, destroying all sins.

1.165.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ravimadhye sthitaḥ somaḥ somamadhye hutāśanaḥ ..
tejomadhye sthitaṃ sattvaṃ sattvamadhye sthito'cyutaḥ .. 4 ..
1.165.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
रविमध्ये स्थितः सोमः सोममध्ये हुताशनः ॥
तेजोमध्ये स्थितं सत्त्वं सत्त्वमध्ये स्थितोऽच्युतः ॥ 4 ॥
1.165.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the midst of the sun stands the moon, in the midst of the moon stands the fire; / in the midst of radiance stands sattva, and in the midst of sattva stands Acyuta.

1.165.s:
aṃguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣaḥ pūrvameva mayeritaḥ ..
śaṅkareṇa tadā dṛṣṭaḥ prabhavaḥ sarvatejasām .. 5 ..
1.165.d:
अंगुष्ठमात्रः पुरुषः पूर्वमेव मयेरितः ॥
शङ्करेण तदा दृष्टः प्रभवः सर्वतेजसाम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.165.m: The thumb-sized Cosmic Person was already spoken of by me earlier; / he was seen then by Śaṅkara as the source of all radiances.

1.165.s:
sa viṣṇurbhuvanādhāro yasyedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ..
vareṇyaṃ tacca saviturbhargavācyaṃ tu yoginām ..6..
1.165.d:
स विष्णुर्भुवनाधारो यस्येदं सकलं जगत् ॥
वरेण्यं तच्च सवितुर्भर्गवाच्यं तु योगिनाम् ॥6॥
1.165.m: He is Viṣṇu, the support of the worlds, to whom belongs this entire universe; / and he is the 'choicest radiance' of Savitṛ that is spoken of to yogins.

1.165.s:
yeyaṃ paraṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ bahirantaśca yādava ..
dhīśabdavācyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pracodayati yaḥ sadā .. 7 ..
1.165.d:
येयं परं तदुद्दिष्टं बहिरन्तश्च यादव ॥
धीशब्दवाच्यं ब्रह्माणं प्रचोदयति यः सदा ॥ 7 ॥
1.165.m: That which is supreme is designated as this, outside and inside, O descendant of Yadu; / he who constantly impels Brahmā, who is denoted by the word 'understanding'.

1.165.s:
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ bhagavānviṣṇuḥ savitā sa prakīrtitaḥ ..
sarvalokaprasavanātsavitā sa tu kīrtyate .. 8 ..
1.165.d:
सृष्ट्यर्थं भगवान्विष्णुः सविता स प्रकीर्तितः ॥
सर्वलोकप्रसवनात्सविता स तु कीर्त्यते ॥ 8 ॥
1.165.m: For the purpose of creation, the blessed Viṣṇu is proclaimed as Savitṛ; / he is celebrated as Savitṛ because he brings forth all the worlds.

1.165.s:
yatastaddevadevatyā sāvitrītyucyate tataḥ ..
gānādvā trāyate yasmādgāyatrī vā tadā smṛtā .. 9 ..
1.165.d:
यतस्तद्देवदेवत्या सावित्रीत्युच्यते ततः ॥
गानाद्वा त्रायते यस्माद्गायत्री वा तदा स्मृता ॥ 9 ॥
1.165.m: Since that god is its deity, it is therefore called Sāvitrī; / or, since it protects from singing, it is regarded then as Gāyatrī.

1.165.s:
etasmātkāraṇādrājansāvitrī kīrtitā mayā ..
tava dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha nityaṃ vaiṣṇavakarmasu .. 1.165.10 ..
1.165.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्राजन्सावित्री कीर्तिता मया ॥
तव धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ नित्यं वैष्णवकर्मसु ॥ 1.165.10 ॥
1.165.m: For this reason, O king, best among upholders of dharma, / the Sāvitrī has always been declared by me to you in Vaiṣṇava rites.

1.165.s:
savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha ..
ye japanti sadā teṣāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit .. 11 ..
1.165.d:
सव्याहृतीकप्रणवां गायत्रीं शिरसा सह ॥
ये जपन्ति सदा तेषां न भयं विद्यते क्वचित् ॥ 11 ॥
1.165.m: Those who constantly chant the Gāyatrī together with the vyāhṛtis, the praṇava, and the head, / have no fear anywhere.

1.165.s:
daśakṛtvā prajaptā sā rātryahnā yatkṛtaṃ laghu ..
tatpāpaṃ praṇudatyāśu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 12 ..
1.165.d:
दशकृत्वा प्रजप्ता सा रात्र्यह्ना यत्कृतं लघु ॥
तत्पापं प्रणुदत्याशु नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 12 ॥
1.165.m: Repeated ten times, it quickly dispels whatever minor sin / has been committed by night or by day; there is no doubt about this.

1.165.s:
śataṃ japtā tu sā devī pāpopaśamanā smṛtā ..
sahasrajaptā sā devī copapātakanāśinī .. 13 ..
lakṣajāpena ca tathā mahāpātakanāśinī .. 13 ..
1.165.d:
शतं जप्ता तु सा देवी पापोपशमना स्मृता ॥
सहस्रजप्ता सा देवी चोपपातकनाशिनी ॥ 13 ॥
लक्षजापेन च तथा महापातकनाशिनी ॥ 13 ॥
1.165.m:
Chanted a hundred times, that goddess is regarded as pacifying sins; / chanted a thousand times, that goddess destroys minor offenses;
and by a hundred thousand repetitions, she destroys the great mortal sins.

1.165.s: koṭijāpyena rājendra yadicchati tadāpnuyāt .. 14 ..
1.165.d: कोटिजाप्येन राजेन्द्र यदिच्छति तदाप्नुयात् ॥ 14 ॥
1.165.m: By ten million repetitions, O best of kings, one obtains whatever one desires:

1.165.s:
vidyādharatvaṃ yakṣatvaṃ gandharvatvamathāpi vā ..
devatvamathavā rājyaṃ bhūrloke hatakaṇṭakam .. 15 ..
1.165.d:
विद्याधरत्वं यक्षत्वं गन्धर्वत्वमथापि वा ॥
देवत्वमथवा राज्यं भूर्लोके हतकण्टकम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.165.m: the state of a vidyādhara, a yakṣa, or a gandharva, / or godhood, or an unhindered kingdom on the earth.

1.165.s:
koṭisāhasrajāpyena niṣkāmaḥ puruṣottama ..
vidhinā rājaśārdūla prāpnoti paramaṃ padam .. 16 ..
1.165.d:
कोटिसाहस्रजाप्येन निष्कामः पुरुषोत्तम ॥
विधिना राजशार्दूल प्राप्नोति परमं पदम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.165.m: By reciting [it] ten thousand times ten million, one free from desire, O Puruṣottama, / according to the prescribed rule, O tiger among kings, attains the supreme state.

1.165.s:
yathā kathañcijjaptaiṣā devī paramapāvanī ..
sarvakāmapradā proktā vidhinā kimpunarnṛpa .. 17 ...
1.165.d:
यथा कथञ्चिज्जप्तैषा देवी परमपावनी ॥
सर्वकामप्रदा प्रोक्ता विधिना किम्पुनर्नृप ॥ 17 ॥।
1.165.m: Even when recited in any manner whatsoever, this goddess is the supreme purifier, / declared to grant all desires; how much more so according to rule, O king?

1.165.s:
.. vajra uvāca ..
vidhinā kena japtavyā gāyatrī pāpanāśinī ..
mahāpavitrā paramā sarvakalyāṇakāritā. .. 18 ..
1.165.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
विधिना केन जप्तव्या गायत्री पापनाशिनी ॥
महापवित्रा परमा सर्वकल्याणकारिता॥। 18 ॥
1.165.m: Vajra said: / According to what rule should the Gāyatrī be recited—she who destroys sin, / who is supremely pure, excellent, and the bringer of all auspiciousness?

1.165.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kuśaśayyāṃ niviṣṭastu kuśapāṇi jitendriyaḥ ..
arkamadhyagataṃ dhyāyetpuruṣaṃ taṃ mahādyutim .. 19 ..
1.165.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कुशशय्यां निविष्टस्तु कुशपाणि जितेन्द्रियः ॥
अर्कमध्यगतं ध्यायेत्पुरुषं तं महाद्युतिम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.165.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Seated upon a bed of kuśa grass, with kuśa in hand, having conquered the senses, / one should meditate on that Person of great splendour dwelling in the midst of the sun.

1.165.s:
athavārkaṃ mahīpāla bahiḥ snātastvatandritaḥ ..
ananyacitto medhāvī pūrvāhne tu viśeṣataḥ .. 1.165.20 ..
1.165.d:
अथवार्कं महीपाल बहिः स्नातस्त्वतन्द्रितः ॥
अनन्यचित्तो मेधावी पूर्वाह्ने तु विशेषतः ॥ 1.165.20 ॥
1.165.m: Or else [standing] outside, O protector of the earth, having bathed, unwearied, / with undivided mind and wise, especially in the forenoon,

1.165.s:
bhaikṣyayāvakaśākāśī payomūlāśano'thavā ..
phalapuṣpāśano vāpi naktaṃ vāpi haviṣyabhuk .. 21 ..
1.165.d:
भैक्ष्ययावकशाकाशी पयोमूलाशनोऽथवा ॥
फलपुष्पाशनो वापि नक्तं वापि हविष्यभुक् ॥ 21 ॥
1.165.m: subsisting on alms, barley gruel, or vegetables, or consuming milk and roots, / or feeding on fruits and flowers, or eating sacrificial food at night,

1.165.s:
anena vidhinā japyaṃ yaḥ karoti mahīpate ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ vāyubhūtaḥ khamūrtimān .. 22 ..
1.165.d:
अनेन विधिना जप्यं यः करोति महीपते ॥
स याति परमं स्थानं वायुभूतः खमूर्तिमान् ॥ 22 ॥
1.165.m: he who undertakes the recitation according to this rule, O lord of the earth, / goes to the supreme abode, turned into wind, having the form of space.

1.165.s:
akāmaḥ kāmakāmastu kāmamāpnotyabhīpsitam ..
savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāḥ prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa .. 23 ..
1.165.d:
अकामः कामकामस्तु काममाप्नोत्यभीप्सितम् ॥
सव्याहृतीकप्रणवाः प्राणायामास्तु षोडश ॥ 23 ॥
1.165.m: Free from desires, but if desiring, he obtains the desired wish. / Sixteen breath-restraints accompanied by the sacred utterances and the praṇava,

1.165.s:
api bhrūṇahaṇaṃ māsātpunantyaharahaḥ kṛtāḥ ..
savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha .. 24 ..
1.165.d:
अपि भ्रूणहणं मासात्पुनन्त्यहरहः कृताः ॥
सव्याहृतीकप्रणवां गायत्रीं शिरसा सह ॥ 24 ॥
1.165.m: performed day after day, purify even the killer of an embryo after a month. / The Gāyatrī accompanied by the sacred utterances and the praṇava, along with the [Gāyatrī-]head,

1.165.s:
triḥ paṭhedāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate ..
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kāryaṃ kalyamutthāya vai dvijaḥ .. 25 ..
1.165.d:
त्रिः पठेदायतप्राणः प्राणायामः स उच्यते ॥
प्राणायामत्रयं कार्यं कल्यमुत्थाय वै द्विजः ॥ 25 ॥
1.165.m: one should recite thrice with held breath; that is called a breath-restraint. / A twice-born, having risen at dawn, must perform three breath-restraints;

1.165.s:
ahorātrakṛtātpāpāttakṣaṇādeva mucyate ..
sarvadoṣaharaṃ proktaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ dvijanmanām .. 26 ..
1.165.d:
अहोरात्रकृतात्पापात्तक्षणादेव मुच्यते ॥
सर्वदोषहरं प्रोक्तं प्राणायामं द्विजन्मनाम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.165.m: he is instantly freed from the sin committed day and night. / Breath-restraint is declared to remove all faults for the twice-born.

1.165.s:
tatastvabhyadhikaṃ nāsti rājanparamapāvanam ..
prāṇasaṃdhāraṇaṃ māsaṃ kuśāgracyutabindunā .. 27 ..
1.165.d:
ततस्त्वभ्यधिकं नास्ति राजन्परमपावनम् ॥
प्राणसंधारणं मासं कुशाग्रच्युतबिन्दुना ॥ 27 ॥
1.165.m: There is nothing superior to that, O king, as a supreme purifier. / Maintaining life for a month with a drop falling from the tip of kuśa grass,

1.165.s:
yaḥ kuryādambhasāṃ pānaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ tu tatsamam ..
nirodhājjāyate vāyustasmādagnistato jalam .. 28 ..
1.165.d:
यः कुर्यादम्भसां पानं प्राणायामं तु तत्समम् ॥
निरोधाज्जायते वायुस्तस्मादग्निस्ततो जलम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.165.m: whoever should thus drink water, [the effect] is equal to breath-restraint. / From restraint arises wind; from that, fire; from that, water;

1.165.s:
tribhiḥ śarīraṃ sakalaṃ prāṇāyāmaiśca śudhyati ..
ākeśāgrānnakhāgrācca tapastapyetsa uttamam .. 29 ..
1.165.d:
त्रिभिः शरीरं सकलं प्राणायामैश्च शुध्यति ॥
आकेशाग्रान्नखाग्राच्च तपस्तप्येत्स उत्तमम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.165.m: and by three breath-restraints, the entire body is purified. / From the tips of the hair to the tips of the nails, he performs supreme austerity.

1.165.s:
ātmānaṃ śodhayedyastu prāṇāyāmaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .. 1.165.30 ..
1.165.d:
आत्मानं शोधयेद्यस्तु प्राणायामैः पुनःपुनः ॥
श्रावण्यां पौर्णमास्यां तु सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः ॥ 1.165.30 ॥
1.165.m: He who purifies himself again and again by breath-restraints, / fasting on the full-moon day of Śrāvaṇa, with conquered senses,

1.165.s:
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ..
antarjale trirāvartya gāyatrīṃ prayato japan .. 31 ..
1.165.d:
प्राणायामशतं कृत्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥
अन्तर्जले त्रिरावर्त्य गायत्रीं प्रयतो जपन् ॥ 31 ॥
1.165.m: and performing a hundred breath-restraints, is freed from all sins. / Having submerged in water and repeatedly reciting Gāyatrī thrice, restrained,

1.165.s:
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairyadi na brahmahā bhavet ..
nāsti satyātparo dharmo nāsti kṛṣṇasamā gatiḥ .. 32 ..
1.165.d:
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर्यदि न ब्रह्महा भवेत् ॥
नास्ति सत्यात्परो धर्मो नास्ति कृष्णसमा गतिः ॥ 32 ॥
1.165.m: he is freed from all sins, provided he is not a killer of a brahmin. / There is no dharma higher than truth; there is no refuge equal to Kṛṣṇa;

1.165.s:
gāyatryāśca paraṃ nāsti divi ceha ca pāvanam ..
hutā ca varadā devī sarvakāmaphalapradā .. 33 ..
1.165.d:
गायत्र्याश्च परं नास्ति दिवि चेह च पावनम् ॥
हुता च वरदा देवी सर्वकामफलप्रदा ॥ 33 ॥
1.165.m: and there is nothing purifying in heaven or on earth higher than the Gāyatrī. / When offered into the fire, the goddess grants boons and yields the fruit of all desires.

1.165.s:
gāyatryāḥ sutilairhomaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ ..
śāntikāmo yavaiḥ kuryādāyuṣkāmo ghṛtena ca .. 34 ..
1.165.d:
गायत्र्याः सुतिलैर्होमः सर्वपापप्रणाशनः ॥
शान्तिकामो यवैः कुर्यादायुष्कामो घृतेन च ॥ 34 ॥
1.165.m: An oblation of the Gāyatrī with sesame completely destroys all sins. / One desiring peace should perform it with barley; one desiring longevity, with ghee;

1.165.s:
karmaṇāṃ siddhikāmastu kuryātsiddhārthakairnaraḥ..
brahmavarcasakāmastu payasā sa samācaret .. 35 ..
1.165.d:
कर्मणां सिद्धिकामस्तु कुर्यात्सिद्धार्थकैर्नरः॥
ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्तु पयसा स समाचरेत् ॥ 35 ॥
1.165.m: a man desiring success in undertakings should perform it with white mustard; / one desiring spiritual lustre should do so with milk;

1.165.s:
putrakāmastathā dadhnā dhānyakāmastu śālibhiḥ ..
kṣīravṛkṣasamidbhiśca grahapīḍāpraśāntaye .. 36 ..
1.165.d:
पुत्रकामस्तथा दध्ना धान्यकामस्तु शालिभिः ॥
क्षीरवृक्षसमिद्भिश्च ग्रहपीडाप्रशान्तये ॥ 36 ॥
1.165.m: one desiring a son, likewise, with curd; one desiring grain, with rice; / and with kindling sticks of milky trees for the appeasement of planetary afflictions;

1.165.s:
dhanakāmastathā bilvaiḥ śrīkāmaḥ kamalaistathā ..
ārogyakāmaḥ kṣīrāktaiḥ kuryāddūrvāṅkuraiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 37 ..
1.165.d:
धनकामस्तथा बिल्वैः श्रीकामः कमलैस्तथा ॥
आरोग्यकामः क्षीराक्तैः कुर्याद्दूर्वाङ्कुरैः शुभैः ॥ 37 ॥
1.165.m: likewise, one desiring wealth with bilva leaves; one desiring fortune with lotuses; / one desiring health should perform it with auspicious dūrvā sprouts smeared with milk.

1.165.s:
deśopasarge saṃprāpte tadeva ca vidhīyate ..
guggulorgulikābhistu kṛtvā homamatandritaḥ .. 38 ..
1.165.d:
देशोपसर्गे संप्राप्ते तदेव च विधीयते ॥
गुग्गुलोर्गुलिकाभिस्तु कृत्वा होममतन्द्रितः ॥ 38 ॥
1.165.m: When a calamity befalls the country, that very [offering] is prescribed. / Having performed the fire-offering unwearied with pellets of guggulu,

1.165.s:
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
pāyasena tathā hutvā vidyāṃ samadhigacchati ..
yenayena tu kāmena lakṣahomaṃ samācaret .. 39 ..
1.165.d:
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
पायसेन तथा हुत्वा विद्यां समधिगच्छति ॥
येनयेन तु कामेन लक्षहोमं समाचरेत् ॥ 39 ॥
1.165.m: one attains great good fortune; there is no doubt about this. / Likewise, having offered milk-rice, one acquires sacred knowledge. / With whatever desire one performs a hundred-thousand fire-offering,

1.165.s:
tadeva kāmamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..
kṛcchreṇa śuddhimutpādya prāṇāyāmaśatena ca .. 1.165.40 ..
1.165.d:
तदेव काममाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
कृच्छ्रेण शुद्धिमुत्पाद्य प्राणायामशतेन च ॥ 1.165.40 ॥
1.165.m: that very desire one attains; there is no doubt about this. / Having produced purification by means of a kṛcchra penance and a hundred breath-restraints,

1.165.s:
antarjalena vā japtvā snāto nityamatandritaḥ ..
prāṇāyāmāṃstataḥ kṛtvā vidhinaiva sa ṣoḍaśa .. 41 ..
1.165.d:
अन्तर्जलेन वा जप्त्वा स्नातो नित्यमतन्द्रितः ॥
प्राणायामांस्ततः कृत्वा विधिनैव स षोडश ॥ 41 ॥
1.165.m: or having recited underwater, having bathed, continually unwearied, / then having performed sixteen breath-restraints strictly according to rule,

1.165.s:
pūrvāhṇe juhuyādvahnau susamiddhe yathāvidhi ..
bhaikṣyayāvakaśākāśī phalamūlāśano'thavā .. .. 42 ..
1.165.d:
पूर्वाह्णे जुहुयाद्वह्नौ सुसमिद्धे यथाविधि ॥
भैक्ष्ययावकशाकाशी फलमूलाशनोऽथवा ॥ ॥ 42 ॥
1.165.m: one should offer in the forenoon into a well-kindled fire according to the ordinance, / eating alms, barley gruel, or vegetables, or eating fruits and roots,

1.165.s:
kṣīrasaktūghṛtāhārī bhavedatha vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
āhārāṇāṃ yathoktānāmekāhāraṃ samāśrayet .. 43 ..
1.165.d:
क्षीरसक्तूघृताहारी भवेदथ विचक्षणः ॥
आहाराणां यथोक्तानामेकाहारं समाश्रयेत् ॥ 43 ॥
1.165.m: or the wise man should be one who subsists on milk, roasted barley flour, or ghee. / Among the diets as mentioned, he should adhere to a single diet,

1.165.s:
yāvatsamāptirbhavati lakṣahomasya pārthiva ..
lakṣahomāvasāne tu brāhmaṇānāṃ tu dakṣiṇā .. 44 ..
1.165.d:
यावत्समाप्तिर्भवति लक्षहोमस्य पार्थिव ॥
लक्षहोमावसाने तु ब्राह्मणानां तु दक्षिणा ॥ 44 ॥
1.165.m: until the completion of the hundred-thousand fire-offering, O ruler of the earth. / At the end of the hundred-thousand fire-offering, a sacrificial fee to brahmins

1.165.s:
deyā bhavati rājendra gāvo vastrāṇi kāñcanam ..
sarvotpātasamutpattau brāhmaṇairanupūjitaiḥ .. 45..
1.165.d:
देया भवति राजेन्द्र गावो वस्त्राणि काञ्चनम् ॥
सर्वोत्पातसमुत्पत्तौ ब्राह्मणैरनुपूजितैः ॥ 45॥
1.165.m: is to be given, O king of kings: cows, garments, and gold. / Upon the occurrence of all portents, by brahmins duly honoured,

1.165.s:
pañcabhirdaśabhirvāpi lakṣahomaṃ samācaret ..
asaṅkīrṇaistathā hārairnṛpatistatpraśāntaye .. 46 ..
1.165.d:
पञ्चभिर्दशभिर्वापि लक्षहोमं समाचरेत् ॥
असङ्कीर्णैस्तथा हारैर्नृपतिस्तत्प्रशान्तये ॥ 46 ॥
1.165.m: by five or even ten, the king should perform the hundred-thousand fire-offering / with unmixed diets for the appeasement thereof.

1.165.s:
nāsti loke sa utpāto yo hyanena na śāmyati ..
maṅgalaṃ paramaṃ nāsti yattasmādatiricyate .. 47 ..
1.165.d:
नास्ति लोके स उत्पातो यो ह्यनेन न शाम्यति ॥
मङ्गलं परमं नास्ति यत्तस्मादतिरिच्यते ॥ 47 ॥
1.165.m: There is no portent in the world that is not appeased by this. / There is no supreme auspiciousness that surpasses it.

1.165.s:
koṭihomaṃ tu yo rājā kārayetpūrvavaddvijaiḥ ..
na tasya śatravaḥ saṅkhye jātu tiṣṭhanti karhicit .. 48 ..
1.165.d:
कोटिहोमं तु यो राजा कारयेत्पूर्ववद्द्विजैः ॥
न तस्य शत्रवः सङ्ख्ये जातु तिष्ठन्ति कर्हिचित् ॥ 48 ॥
1.165.m: The king who causes a ten-million fire-offering to be performed by twice-borns as before, / his enemies never stand [against him] in battle at any time.

1.165.s:
na tasya maraṇaṃ deśe na vyādhirjāyate tathā ..
ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirmūṣakāḥ śalabhāḥ śakāḥ .. 49 ..
1.165.d:
न तस्य मरणं देशे न व्याधिर्जायते तथा ॥
अतिवृष्टिरनावृष्टिर्मूषकाः शलभाः शकाः ॥ 49 ॥
1.165.m: In his realm, death does not occur, nor does disease arise. / Excessive rain, drought, mice, locusts, parrots,

1.165.s:
rākṣasāśca praśāmyanti sarvāstatra tathetayaḥ ..
rasavanti ca toyāni sasyāni svāduvanti ca .. 1.165.50 ..
1.165.d:
राक्षसाश्च प्रशाम्यन्ति सर्वास्तत्र तथेतयः ॥
रसवन्ति च तोयानि सस्यानि स्वादुवन्ति च ॥ 1.165.50 ॥
1.165.m: and rākṣasas are appeased there, and likewise all agricultural calamities. / And the waters become savoury and the crops become sweet-tasting,

1.165.s:
jāyante tasya deśe tu dharmiṣṭhaśca jano bhavet ..
koṭihome tu varayedbrāhmaṇānviṃśatīnnṛpa .. 51 ..
1.165.d:
जायन्ते तस्य देशे तु धर्मिष्ठश्च जनो भवेत् ॥
कोटिहोमे तु वरयेद्ब्राह्मणान्विंशतीन्नृप ॥ 51 ॥
1.165.m: and they grow in his land, and the people become devoted to dharma. / For the ten-million fire-offering, one should appoint twenty brahmins, O king,

1.165.s:
śataṃ vātha sahasraṃ vā ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ ..
koṭihomaṃ svayaṃ yastu kuryādbrāhmaṇasattamaḥ .. 52 ..
1.165.d:
शतं वाथ सहस्रं वा य इच्छेद्भूतिमात्मनः ॥
कोटिहोमं स्वयं यस्तु कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणसत्तमः ॥ 52 ॥
1.165.m: or a hundred, or a thousand, whoever desires prosperity for himself. / But the foremost among brahmins who himself performs the ten-million fire-offering,

1.165.s:
kṣatriyo vāthavā vaiśyastasya puṇyaphalaṃ mahat ..
yadyadicchati kāmānāṃ tattadāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 53 ..
1.165.d:
क्षत्रियो वाथवा वैश्यस्तस्य पुण्यफलं महत् ॥
यद्यदिच्छति कामानां तत्तदाप्नोत्यसंशयम् ॥ 53 ॥
1.165.m: or a kṣatriya, or a vaiśya, his reward of merit is great. / Whatever desires he wishes for, all those he obtains without doubt.

1.165.s:
saśarīro'pi cedgantuṃ divamicchettadāpnuyāt ..
sāvitrī paramā devī sāvitrī pāvanī param .. 54 ..
1.165.d:
सशरीरोऽपि चेद्गन्तुं दिवमिच्छेत्तदाप्नुयात् ॥
सावित्री परमा देवी सावित्री पावनी परम् ॥ 54 ॥
1.165.m: Even if he should wish to go to heaven with his physical body, he would attain that. / Sāvitrī is the supreme goddess; Sāvitrī is the ultimate purifier;

1.165.s:
sarvakāmapradā devī sāvitrī kathitā tathā ..
abhicāreṣu tāṃ devīṃ viparītāṃ prayojayet ..55 ..
1.165.d:
सर्वकामप्रदा देवी सावित्री कथिता तथा ॥
अभिचारेषु तां देवीं विपरीतां प्रयोजयेत् ॥55 ॥
1.165.m: likewise, the goddess Sāvitrī is declared to be the bestower of all desires. / In rituals of sorcery, one should employ that goddess in reverse.

1.165.s:
kāryā vyāhṛtayaścātra viparītākṣarāstathā ..
viparītākṣaraṃ kāryaṃ śiraśca manujeśvara .. 56 ..
1.165.d:
कार्या व्याहृतयश्चात्र विपरीताक्षरास्तथा ॥
विपरीताक्षरं कार्यं शिरश्च मनुजेश्वर ॥ 56 ॥
